HKMA Deputy Chief Expresses Confidence in Banking System Stability | China Labour Bulletin Board
Friday, 6 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
HKMA Deputy Chief Expresses Confidence in Banking System Stability
Hong Kong Monetary Authority Deputy Chief Executive Eddie Yue expressed confidence in the banking system's stability, citing strong deposit and loan growth, adequate provisions, and manageable credit risks.
The Hong Kong Monetary Authority's (HKMA) Deputy Chief Executive, Eddie Yue, expressed confidence in the stability of the banking system during a briefing on 6 November 2026.
Yue reported that in the first nine months of the year, total deposits and loans both rose by 7.7 per cent. On an annualised basis, deposits grew over 10 per cent and loans increased more than 10.2 per cent. Loans for local and overseas use, as well as trade finance, all recorded rapid growth. Trade finance alone expanded by 20 per cent in the first nine months.
The deputy chief further noted that the banking sector's capital levels, liquidity ratios and profitability parameters were all performing well. He said he had confidence in the stability of the banking industry.
According to Yue, the preliminary ratio of classified loans in the third quarter remained stable compared with the end of the second quarter. He added that banks had adequate provision levels. The provision coverage ratio, excluding collateral, stood at about 65 per cent. When the realisation value of collateral was included, the coverage ratio reached 150 per cent.
Yue concluded that the overall credit risk was currently manageable.

香港金管局就能源价格和人工智能投资风险发出警告中国劳工公告栏
星期五, 6 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
金管局就能源价格和人工智能投资风险发出警告
香港金融管理局总裁余伟文告诉立法者，全球经济面临两个风险点：能源价格上涨和人工智能相关投资。他指出，美国中期选举后人工智能股票大幅下跌，而香港第三季度经济增长达到5.2%。
香港金融管理局(金管局)总裁余伟文表示，第三季度香港经济增长5.2%，投资和消费均增长。截至10月底，首次公开发行募集资金超过3800亿港元，是去年全年募集资金总额的1.4倍，位居全球第二。交易量保持稳定。
岳在立法会金融事务委员会会议上表示，全球货币状况继续收紧。美国9月加息，市场预计12月或明年初再次加息。近几个月来，美元走强，提高了使用美元的企业的融资成本。
他指出了两个全球风险点：能源价格上涨和人工智能相关投资。岳指出，人工智能股票隔夜大幅下跌，他将这与美国中期选举联系起来。
关于中国大陆经济，岳表示，第三季度增长略好于预期，出口强劲。但投资较前两季度有所下降，消费则有所回升。北京加大了政策支持力度，包括新增地方政府专项贷款和新的政策工具。
岳表示，由于香港与美国的利差超过100个基点，港元汇率已向弱方可兑换承诺水平走弱，创造了套利机会。与股市活动相关的港元需求也略有放缓，但他形容这是正常现象，并表示市场运作平稳。
第三季度房地产价格小幅下跌 0.8%，交易量降至略高于 13,000 套。岳将此归因于利率和中东局势等不确定因素。

HKMA warns on energy prices and AI investment risks | China Labour Bulletin Board
Friday, 6 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
HKMA warns on energy prices and AI investment risks
Hong Kong Monetary Authority chief Eddie Yue told lawmakers the global economy faces two risk points: rising energy prices and AI-related investments. He noted AI stocks fell sharply after the US midterm elections and that Hong Kong's third-quarter economic growth reached 5.2 per cent.
Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) chief Eddie Yue said the city's economy grew 5.2 per cent in the third quarter, with both investment and consumption rising. By the end of October, initial public offering proceeds had reached more than HK$380 billion, 1.4 times the total for the whole of last year, ranking second globally. Trading volumes remained steady.
Speaking at a Legislative Council financial affairs panel meeting, Yue said global monetary conditions continue to tighten. The US raised interest rates in September, and markets expect another increase in December or early next year. The US dollar has strengthened in recent months, raising financing costs for dollar-using companies.
He identified two global risk points: rising energy prices and investments related to artificial intelligence. Yue noted that AI stocks saw a significant decline overnight, which he linked to the US midterm elections.
On the mainland Chinese economy, Yue said third-quarter growth was slightly better than expected, with strong exports. However, investment fell compared with the previous two quarters, while consumption rebounded. Beijing has increased policy support, including new special loans for local governments and new policy tools.
Yue said the Hong Kong dollar exchange rate had weakened towards the weak-side convertibility undertaking level, as the interest rate gap between Hong Kong and the US exceeded 100 basis points, creating arbitrage opportunities. Demand for Hong Kong dollars related to stock market activity had also eased slightly, but he described this as normal and said the market was operating smoothly.
Property prices fell slightly by 0.8 per cent in the third quarter, with transactions dropping to just over 13,000. Yue attributed this to uncertainties including interest rates and the situation in the Middle East.

香港邮政公布2027年上半年邮票计划 |中国劳工公告栏
星期五, 6 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
香港邮政公布2027年上半年邮票计划
香港邮政宣布推出六款全新通用邮票，以香港地标为主题，并推出有关羊年、新界北部、国家安全教育、公共房屋及远足径的特别邮票。预订现已开放至 11 月 23 日。
香港邮政公布2027年1月至6月的邮票发行计划详情，包括六枚全新通用邮票及多枚特别及纪念邮票。新的通用邮票延续2025年香港通用邮票系列的设计风格，描绘启德体育公园、香港夜景、香港国际机场三跑道系统、狮子山、凌霄阁及沙罗塘等本地地标。
农历新年，香港邮政将发行第五组生肖邮票第四套，以纪念羊年。该套装包括四张邮票和两张微型邮票，展示了不同姿势的山羊，并带有鲜花和节日图案。亦会发行《骏马吉祥羊》金银邮票小型张，以银及22K金箔压印马及羊。新系列“珠光墨浮雕十二生肖邮票-龙、蛇、马、羊”采用珠光墨和浮雕工艺，打造出柔和光泽的效果。亦会与中国邮政及澳门邮政联合发行纪念品文件夹，详情稍后公布。
以新界北部为主题的特别邮票将展示四个园区：高端专业服务及物流枢纽、创新科技区、边境工贸区、蓝绿休闲旅游生态区。该问题凸显了该地区作为香港经济未来引擎的作用以及香港发展成为国际创新科技中心的作用。
为庆祝4月15日国家安全教育日，香港邮政将发行纪念邮票以宣扬国家安全意识。该邮票是继香港首个国家安全展览馆于2024年8月启用后推出的一套四枚特别邮票《香港公营房屋的发展II》，将阐释多元化的福祉理念如何为居民创造更舒适的居住环境和公共空间。最后，继早前的大屿山径、麦理浩径和卫奕信径之后，行山径系列的第四期（即最后一期）将以香港径为主题。
顾客可于即日起至11月23日期间透过邮购网网上平台(shopthrupost.hongkongpost.hk)或香港邮政邮票Facebook专页(www.facebook.com/HKPStamps)预购所有商品。 11 月 23 日之前订购的顾客将获得免费礼物和奖励积分。如有查询，请致电集邮热线2785 5711或浏览stamps.hongkongpost.hk。

Hongkong Post unveils stamp programme for first half of 2027
Hongkong Post has announced six new definitive stamps featuring Hong Kong landmarks, along with special issues on the Year of the Goat, Northern New Territories, national security education, public housing and hiking trails. Pre-orders are open now until 23 November.
Hongkong Post has released details of its stamp issuance programme for January to June 2027, featuring six new definitive stamps and several special and commemorative issues. The new definitive stamps continue the design style of the 2025 Hong Kong Definitive Stamp series, depicting local landmarks including the Kai Tak Sports Park, the Hong Kong夜景, the Hong Kong International Airport Three-runway System, Lion Rock, the Peak Tower and Sha Lo Tong.
For the Lunar New Year, Hongkong Post will issue the fourth set of the fifth series of festive zodiac stamps to mark the Year of the Goat. The set comprises four stamps and two miniature sheets showing goats in different poses, with flowers and festive motifs. A "Gallant Horse and Auspicious Goat" gold-and-silver stamp miniature sheet will also be released, with the horse and goat embossed in silver and 22K gold foil. A new series, the "Pearlescent Ink Embossed Zodiac Stamps – Dragon, Snake, Horse, Goat", applies pearlescent ink and embossing to create a soft, lustrous finish. A joint souvenir folder with China Post and Macau Post will also be issued, details of which will be announced later.
A special stamp set themed on the Northern New Territories will showcase four zones: high-end professional services and logistics hub, innovation and technology zone, border trade and industry area, and blue-green recreation and tourism ecological zone. The issue highlights the region's role as a future engine for Hong Kong's economy and its development into an international innovation and technology centre.
To mark National Security Education Day on 15 April, Hongkong Post will issue a commemorative stamp promoting national security awareness. The stamp follows the opening of Hong Kong's first national security exhibition hall in August 2024. A new set of four special stamps, "Development of Hong Kong Public Housing II", will illustrate how diversified concepts of well-being create more comfortable living environments and public spaces for residents. Finally, the fourth and final issue in the hiking trail series will feature the Hong Kong Trail, following earlier issues on the Lantau Trail, MacLehose Trail and Wilson Trail.
Customers can pre-order all items from now until 23 November via the ShopThruPost online platform (shopthrupost.hongkongpost.hk) or the Hongkong Post Stamps Facebook page (www.facebook.com/HKPStamps). Those who order by 23 November will receive a free gift and reward points. For enquiries, contact the Philatelic Hotline at 2785 5711 or visit stamps.hongkongpost.hk.

香港海关关长概述了加强违禁品侦查的多层次战略中国劳工公告栏
星期五, 6 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
香港海关关长概述了加强违禁品侦查的多层次战略
海关关长陈子达表示，该部门正在使用先进的 X 射线扫描仪、大数据分析和人工智能算法来改进对违禁品的拦截。他还注意到与电子商务平台的合作以及员工流动率的下降。
随着网上购物变得越来越流行，海关关长陈子达制定了一项多层次策略，以增强海关拦截进出香港违禁物品的能力。
陈茂波接受香港电台广播道聊天室访问时表示，部门今年已完成贸易单一窗口第3A阶段，让陆路货运数据可透过平台提交。海关现在可以利用大数据分析和人工智能算法来识别异常或高风险的货物进行检查。
陈说，海关亦部署先进的X光机扫描集装箱是否有违禁品，并与物流业合作，加快在清关过程中发现问题货物的速度。
陈补充说，今年，该部门与三个最大的电子商务平台签署了谅解备忘录。这些协议帮助平台运营商了解哪些商品在香港受到监管，不能在香港上市或运输。如果发现高风险货物，可以提前向海关发出警报，使前线执法更加有效。
陈还指出，海关依靠强大的情报系统以及与中国内地和国际伙伴的合作来提高其违禁品侦查能力。
在人员配置方面，陈表示过去两年部门的流动率大幅下降。最近的招聘活动每个职位都吸引了数千至数万名申请人，他说这反映了海关作为雇主的吸引力。部门亦招募了多名前运动员，他们的身体素质、纪律和团队精神均符合纪律部队的要求。陈表示这是一个双赢的安排，解决了运动员退役后的就业需求。

Hong Kong Customs chief outlines multi-layered strategy to boost contraband detection | China Labour Bulletin Board
Friday, 6 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong Customs chief outlines multi-layered strategy to boost contraband detection
Customs chief Chan Tsz-tat says the department is using advanced X-ray scanners, big data analytics and AI algorithms to improve interception of prohibited goods. He also notes partnerships with e-commerce platforms and a drop in staff turnover.
Customs Commissioner Chan Tsz-tat has outlined a multi-layered strategy to enhance the department's ability to intercept prohibited goods entering or leaving Hong Kong, as online shopping becomes more popular.
In an interview with RTHK's Broadcast Drive Chat Room, Chan said the department this year completed Phase 3A of the Trade Single Window, enabling land cargo data to be submitted through the platform. Customs can now use big data analysis and artificial intelligence algorithms to identify abnormal or high-risk shipments for inspection.
Chan said Customs has also deployed advanced X-ray machines to scan containers for contraband and is cooperating with the logistics industry to speed up the detection of problematic goods during clearance.
This year, the department signed memoranda of understanding with three of the largest e-commerce platforms, Chan added. These agreements help platform operators understand which goods are regulated in Hong Kong and cannot be listed or shipped to the city. If they identify high-risk cargo, they can alert Customs in advance, making frontline enforcement more effective.
Chan also noted that Customs relies on a robust intelligence system and cooperation with mainland Chinese and international partners to improve its contraband detection capabilities.
On staffing, Chan said the department's turnover rate has fallen significantly over the past two years. Recent recruitment drives have attracted thousands to tens of thousands of applicants per position, which he said reflects Customs' appeal as an employer. The department has also recruited many former athletes, whose physical fitness, discipline and team spirit align well with the requirements of disciplined services. Chan described this as a win-win arrangement that addresses athletes' post-retirement employment needs.

summary: 环岛赛将于周六回归，共有 1,500 名水手参加中国劳工布告栏 星期五, 2026 年 11 月 6 日 · 香港 香港和中国劳工英文新闻 环岛赛周六回归，1,500 名船员参加 新鸿基地产公司环岛赛周六回归，约 1,500 名船员参加，其中包括亚运会奖牌获得者。这项45公里的赛事由香港皇家游艇会主办，以追逐赛形式和有利的风力预报为特色。由香港皇家游艇会主办的新鸿基地产环岛赛周六重返维多利亚港
content:
环岛赛将于周六回归，共有 1,500 名水手参加中国劳工公告栏
星期五, 6 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
环岛赛将于周六回归，共有 1,500 名水手参加
新鸿基环岛帆船赛将于周六回归，约有 1,500 名帆船选手参加，其中包括亚运会奖牌获得者。这项45公里的赛事由香港皇家游艇会主办，以追逐赛形式和有利的风力预报为特色。
由香港皇家游艇会主办的新鸿基环岛帆船赛于周六返回维多利亚港，汇聚了来自 200 多支队伍的约 1,500 名船员。这项传统赛事已有160多年的历史，以交错追逐的形式环游香港岛45公里，船队根据等级分批出发。
体育专员庄文婷将主持起步仪式。香港皇家游艇会准将大卫·诺顿表示，继香港帆船队和滑浪风帆队在亚运会上夺得四枚金牌、四枚银牌和两枚铜牌后，今年的阵容由顶级运动员组成。
参赛者包括 29 人组的帆船金牌得主 Ethan Kiu 和 Louis Polson；银牌得主 Tiffany Mak Hiu-tung 和 Emily Polson 驾驶 49erFX；大艇组银牌得主尼古拉斯·哈利迪 (Nicholas Halliday)；以及 49 人队铜牌得主 Akira Luke Sakai 和 Russell Williams Aylsworth。水手彼得·杰索普也将参加比赛。滑浪风帆方面，银牌得主马君正将与郑正彦、欧令扬、阿斯加·基卡博伊、苏朗彦、何俊翘及袁正雪一同参赛。 Kikabhoy 去年赢得了风帆冲浪类别的冠军。
诺顿表示，精英运动员的参与将在培养当地年轻人才方面发挥重要作用。他说 15 岁的 Kiu 和 Louis Polson 可以成为同龄人的榜样。他指出，这些年轻人的参与让其他开始航海的孩子感到兴奋。
诺顿还强调了球场沿线的各种风景。水手们将穿过维多利亚港的摩天大楼，然后沿着香港岛南部海岸航行，那里有岩层、清澈的海水和滚滚的海浪，然后在到达终点的途中绕过赤柱。
帆板运动在中断 22 年之后，于去年再次回归这项赛事，但令人沮丧的平静天气迫使大约一半的船队退役。诺顿表示，预计周六的风速将高达 20 节（约每小时 37 公里），天气条件可能有利于打破多项级别记录。来自珀斯、欧洲和美国的国际竞争对手预计也将加入竞争。

Around the Island Race returns Saturday with 1,500 sailors | China Labour Bulletin Board
Friday, 6 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Around the Island Race returns Saturday with 1,500 sailors
The Sun Hung Kai & Co Around the Island Race returns on Saturday with about 1,500 sailors, including Asian Games medallists. Organised by the Royal Hong Kong Yacht Club, the 45km event features a pursuit format and favourable wind forecasts.
The Sun Hung Kai & Co Around the Island Race, organised by the Royal Hong Kong Yacht Club, returns to Victoria Harbour on Saturday, bringing together about 1,500 sailors from more than 200 teams. The traditional event, with a history spanning more than 160 years, features a 45-kilometre circumnavigation of Hong Kong Island in a staggered pursuit format, with fleets starting in batches according to their ratings.
Commissioner for Sports Polly Chong Man-ting will officiate the starting ceremony. Royal Hong Kong Yacht Club commodore David Norton said this year’s line-up features top athletes, following the Hong Kong sailing and windsurfing teams’ success at the Asian Games, where they won four gold, four silver and two bronze medals.
Among the competitors are sailing gold medallists Ethan Kiu and Louis Polson in the 29er class; silver medallists Tiffany Mak Hiu-tung and Emily Polson in the 49erFX; silver medallist Nicholas Halliday in the big-boat division; and 49er bronze medallists Akira Luke Sakai and Russell Williams Aylsworth. Sailor Peter Jessop will also compete. In windsurfing, silver medallist Ma Kwan-ching will be joined by Cheng Ching-yin, Au Ling-yeung, Asgar Kikabhoy, So Long-yin, Curtis Ho Chun-kiu and Yuen Ching-suet. Kikabhoy won the windsurfing category last year.
Norton said the participation of elite athletes will be prominent in nurturing young local talent. He said 15-year-olds Kiu and Louis Polson could serve as role models for their peers. He noted that having these young people taking part gives excitement to other children who are starting to sail.
Norton also highlighted the variety of scenery along the course. Sailors will pass the skyscrapers of Victoria Harbour before heading along Hong Kong Island’s southern coast, with its rock formations, clear waters and rolling swells, and then loop past Stanley on their way to the finish.
Windsurfing made its long-awaited return to the event last year after a 22-year hiatus, though frustratingly calm conditions forced about half the fleet to retire. With forecasts predicting winds of up to 20 knots – about 37 kilometres per hour – on Saturday, Norton said conditions could be favourable for several class records to be broken. International competitors from Perth, Europe and the United States are also expected to add to the competition.

title: Hong Kong police Smart View CCTV helps solve 2,192 crimes, find missing dementia patient in 20 minutes
zh_title: 香港警方Smart View CCTV协助破获2,192宗罪案，20分钟找到失踪痴呆症患者
summary: 香港警方Smart View CCTV协助破获2,192宗罪案，20分钟找到失踪痴呆症患者 |中国劳工布告栏 星期五, 2026 年 11 月 6 日 · 香港 香港和中国劳工英文新闻 香港警方 Smart View CCTV 帮助破获 2,192 起犯罪案件，在 20 分钟内找到失踪的痴呆症患者 香港警方表示，截至 10 月 31 日，Smart View CCTV 计划已帮助破获 2,192 起刑事案件并逮捕 2,831 人。总督察梁贤文重点介绍了20分钟内找到失踪痴呆症患者、1小时内抓获伪装劫匪等案件。 11 月 6 日
content:
香港警方Smart View CCTV协助破获2,192宗罪案，20分钟找到失踪痴呆症患者 |中国劳工公告栏
星期五, 6 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
香港警方Smart View CCTV协助破获2,192宗罪案，20分钟找到失踪痴呆症患者
香港警方表示，截至 10 月 31 日，Smart View CCTV 计划已帮助破获 2,192 起刑事案件并逮捕 2,831 人。总督察梁贤文重点介绍了20分钟内找到失踪痴呆症患者、1小时内抓获伪装劫匪等案件。
2026 年 11 月 6 日，香港时间 03:07 · 更新于 11 月 6 日，04:25 · 阅读时间 2 分钟
香港警方表示，截至 10 月 31 日，Smart View CCTV 计划已帮助破获 2,192 起刑事案件并逮捕 2,831 人，涉及谋杀、纵火、入室盗窃和抢劫等严重罪行。
行动科总督察梁贤文分享一名患有认知障碍症和高血压的八十多岁老人在护老院失踪并与家人失去联系的个案。由于没有手机、没有八达通卡，也没有准确的线索，搜寻过程极其困难。警方利用面部识别技术将该男子的照片输入 Smart View 系统，迅速查明了他最后的已知位置。接到报告后，大约一个半小时后，警察在 20 分钟内找到了他，并将他安全带回。
梁说，寻找失踪人员往往需要大规模部署，需要数小时甚至数天的时间，但有了人工智能的帮助，时间可以缩短到几分钟，这对于挽救高危失踪人员的生命具有重要意义。
在另一起案件中，一名劫匪戴着帽子和口罩，更换衣服并使用不同的交通工具来逃避侦查，被Smart View抓获，显示了他的真实外貌和动作。报道发生后约一小时，他在距现场 10 公里处被捕。
在一起刑事毁坏案件中，警方使用 Smart View 的自动车牌识别功能来识别可疑车辆。系统显示，同一个车牌出现在相距太远、短时间内无法到达的两个地方，这表明这是一个假车牌。警察在逮捕之前比较了车辆的一些小特征并澄清了真正的车牌。
梁强调，人工智能提供全天候“精准线索”，大大提高效率，但自动车牌识别和面部识别只是帮助警员过滤大数据的工具。最终的判断、资源的调配和执行仍然完全依赖于官员的专业分析和决定。

Hong Kong police Smart View CCTV helps solve 2,192 crimes, find missing dementia patient in 20 minutes
Hong Kong police said the Smart View CCTV scheme has helped solve 2,192 criminal cases and arrest 2,831 people as of 31 October. Chief Inspector Leung Yin-man highlighted cases including finding a missing dementia patient in 20 minutes and catching a disguised robber within an hour.
6 Nov 2026 at 03:07 HKT · updated 6 Nov, 04:25 · 2 min read
Hong Kong police have said the Smart View CCTV scheme has helped solve 2,192 criminal cases and arrest 2,831 people as of 31 October, involving serious offences including murder, arson, burglary and robbery.
Chief Inspector Leung Yin-man of the Operations Bureau shared a case in which an octogenarian with dementia and hypertension went missing from a care home and lost contact with his family. With no mobile phone or Octopus card and no precise leads, the search was extremely difficult. Police entered the man's photo into the Smart View system using facial recognition, quickly pinpointing his last known location. Officers found him within 20 minutes, about an hour and a half after the report was made, and returned him safely.
Leung said finding missing people often requires large deployments and takes hours or even days, but with AI assistance the time could be cut to minutes, which is significant for saving the lives of high-risk missing people.
In another case, a robber who wore a hat and mask, changed clothes and used different transport to evade detection was captured by Smart View, which revealed his true appearance and movements. He was arrested about an hour after the report, 10 kilometres from the scene.
In a criminal damage case, police used Smart View's automatic number plate recognition to identify a suspect vehicle. The system showed the same plate appearing in two places too far apart to be reached in such a short time, suggesting a fake plate. Officers compared minor vehicle features and clarified the real plate before making an arrest.
Leung stressed that AI provides round-the-clock "precise leads" and greatly improves efficiency, but automatic number plate recognition and facial recognition are only tools to help officers filter big data. Final judgment, resource deployment and enforcement still rely entirely on officers' professional analysis and decisions.

title: Lorry drops box on Fanling Highway, triggers three-vehicle crash
zh_title: 货车在粉岭公路抛下箱子引发三车相撞
summary: 货车在粉岭公路掉下箱子引发三车相撞 |中国劳工布告栏 星期五, 2026 年 11 月 6 日 · 香港 香港及中国劳工英文新闻 货车在粉岭公路丢下箱子，引发三车连环相撞 11 月 6 日，一辆货车在香港附近的粉岭公路丢下一个大纸箱，导致三车连环相撞。一名30岁的张姓司机因耳朵疼痛被送往医院。警方正在调查这起事件。周四网上流传的两段行车记录仪视频显示，一辆货车沿粉岭公路前往元朗，并掉落一辆大型汽车
content:
货车在粉岭公路掉下箱子引发三车相撞 |中国劳工公告栏
星期五, 6 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
货车在粉岭公路抛下箱子引发三车相撞
11月6日，一辆货车在香港附近的粉岭公路上丢失一个大纸箱，导致三车连环相撞。一名30岁的张姓司机因耳朵疼痛被送往医院。警方正在调查这起事件。
周四网上流传的两段行车记录仪视频显示，一辆货车沿着粉岭公路前往元朗，将一个大纸板箱扔到快车道上，显然是因为货物没有固定好。
事件发生在下午5点07分左右。摄影车来不及停车，撞到了箱子，发出一声巨响，将箱子撞到了路中央。可以听到司机咒骂并说他无法及时转向。
几分钟后，下午5时14分，警方接到报案，一辆私家车沿粉岭公路行驶至大坑村附近，看到路上有一个箱子后减速，但后面车辆未能及时停车，造成三车连环追尾。
一名30岁张姓男司机抱怨耳朵疼痛，神志不清被送往北区医院。
网友批评货车司机，称固定货物是基本常识，并称司机不负责任。

Friday, 6 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Lorry drops box on Fanling Highway, triggers three-vehicle crash
A lorry lost a large cardboard box on Fanling Highway near Hong Kong on 6 November, leading to a three-vehicle pile-up. A 30-year-old driver surnamed Cheung was taken to hospital with ear pain. Police are investigating the incident.
Two dashcam videos circulating online on Thursday show a lorry travelling along Fanling Highway towards Yuen Long dropping a large cardboard box onto the fast lane, apparently because its load was not secured.
The incident occurred around 5.07pm. The camera car could not stop in time and hit the box with a loud bang, sending it into the middle of the road. The driver was heard swearing and saying he could not swerve in time.
Minutes later, at 5.14pm, police received a report that a private car travelling along Fanling Highway near Tai Hang Village slowed down after seeing a box on the road, but vehicles behind could not stop in time, causing a three-vehicle pile-up.
A 30-year-old male driver surnamed Cheung complained of ear pain and was taken to North District Hospital conscious.
Netizens criticised the lorry driver, saying securing loads is basic common sense and calling the driver irresponsible.

content:
香港警方“锐眼”计划今年将扩大到私人商场中国劳工公告栏
星期五, 6 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
香港警方“锐眼”计划今年将扩大到私人商场
香港警方表示，他们的“锐眼”闭路电视网络今年将扩展到私人场所，多家商场同意连接他们的摄像机。高级警官梁明立表示，该计划符合法律和安全标准。
2026 年 11 月 6 日，香港时间 00:23 · 更新于 11 月 6 日，04:25 · 阅读时间 1 分钟
香港警方宣布，他们的“锐眼”监控计划今年将扩展到私人场所，一些购物中心已经同意将其闭路电视（CCTV）系统连接到该网络。
警队行动科高级警司梁明立表示，商讨期间商场反应积极，不少人表示有兴趣加入该计划。他将此归因于该计划在破案和预防犯罪方面已被证明有效，并且为已经拥有自己的闭路电视系统的购物中心提供了额外的安全保障。
梁说，警方已咨询法律专家和第三方机构，以确保该计划符合所有监管和监督要求。当被问及商场是否需要添加标牌告知公众这种联系时，他表示警方鼓励采取此类措施，以帮助人们了解预防犯罪的好处并增强安全感。
高级警司指出，将商场闭路电视系统连接到“Sharp Eye”将在未来的调查中节省时间和人力，因为警方不再需要分别向每个地点申请录像或寻找熟悉每个系统的人。
当被问及黑客通过商场闭路电视系统访问“锐眼”收集的数据的风​​险时，梁说该计划的信息安全符合政府的最高标准。他补充说，当局已为该计划投入巨资建设专用光纤网络，使得数据被盗的风险非常低。
据消息人士透露，涉及的商场包括信和集团旗下的奥林匹亚城及屯门市广场；房屋委员会辖下的葵涌商业广场；及位于粉岭的The Latitude，由房屋协会管理。

Friday, 6 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong police 'Sharp Eye' scheme to expand to private malls this year
Hong Kong police say their 'Sharp Eye' CCTV network will expand to private premises this year, with several malls agreeing to connect their cameras. Senior police officer Leung Ming-lap says the scheme meets legal and security standards.
6 Nov 2026 at 00:23 HKT · updated 6 Nov, 04:25 · 1 min read
Hong Kong police have announced that their 'Sharp Eye' surveillance scheme will expand to private premises this year, with several shopping malls already agreeing to connect their closed-circuit television (CCTV) systems to the network.
Senior Superintendent Leung Ming-lap of the force's operations division said the response from malls during discussions had been positive, with many expressing interest in joining the scheme. He attributed this to the scheme's proven effectiveness in solving cases and preventing crime, as well as the added layer of security it provides for malls that already have their own CCTV systems.
Leung said police had consulted legal experts and third-party bodies to ensure the scheme meets all regulatory and oversight requirements. Asked whether malls would need to add signage informing the public of the connection, he said police encouraged such measures to help people understand the crime-prevention benefits and increase their sense of safety.
The senior superintendent noted that connecting mall CCTV systems to 'Sharp Eye' would save time and manpower in future investigations, as police would no longer need to apply separately to each location for footage or find someone familiar with each system.
When asked about the risk of hackers accessing data collected by 'Sharp Eye' through a mall's CCTV system, Leung said the scheme's information security meets the government's highest standards. He added that authorities had invested heavily in a dedicated fibre-optic network for the scheme, making the risk of data theft very low.
According to sources, the malls involved include Olympia City and Tuen Mun Town Plaza, both owned by the Sino Group; Kwai Chung Commercial Plaza, under the Housing Authority; and The Latitude in Fanling, managed by the Housing Society.

content:
香港警方本月将在闭路电视系统中添加人工智能面部识别中国劳工公告栏
星期五, 6 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
香港警方本月将在闭路电视系统中添加人工智能面部识别功能
香港警方本月将在其“Sharp Eye”闭路电视系统中添加人工智能面部识别功能。官员们表示，这项技术已经帮助找到了一名失踪的老人并逮捕了一名抢劫嫌疑人，预计到 2028 年将配备 60,000 个摄像头。
2026 年 11 月 6 日，香港时间 00:11 · 更新于 11 月 6 日，04:25 · 阅读时间 1 分钟
香港警方将于本月在其“锐眼”闭路电视系统中添加人工智能面部识别功能，预计到 2028 年，全市所有 60,000 个摄像头都将配备该功能。高级官员表示，由于计算能力的限制，该技术不会在每个摄像头上同时使用。
警方表示，面部识别功能的测试已经证明是成功的。在一个案例中，警方在接到报告后约 90 分钟内找到了一名患有痴呆症的 80 岁男子。在另一个例子中，系统识别了一名抢劫嫌疑人的面部特征，并检测到他在犯罪后的动作，从而将其逮捕。
警队行动部高级警司梁铭良表示，采用面部识别技术相当于增派警员昼夜不停地监视闭路电视，以发现失踪人员和可疑人员。他表示，这项技术将加快调查速度，减少警员手动查看大量录像的需要，从而可以将更多人员部署到其他职责中。
梁振英表示，面部识别技术准确，是一种成熟、可靠的调查工具，已被中国大陆和海外的执法机构使用。为了保护个人资料和隐私，系统在使用前需要授权，由经过专门培训的人员提出申请，并经督察级以上人员批准。使用后，将进行审查。
截至上月底，“锐眼”项目已帮助破获刑事案件2192起。 Leung表示，由于成本和法律要求，图像的存储时间不会超过31天，而面部识别数据的保留时间不会超过180天。

Hong Kong police to add AI facial recognition to CCTV system this month | China Labour Bulletin Board
Friday, 6 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong police to add AI facial recognition to CCTV system this month
Hong Kong police will add AI facial recognition to its 'Sharp Eye' CCTV system this month. Officials say the technology has already helped locate a missing elderly man and arrest a robbery suspect, with 60,000 cameras expected to be equipped by 2028.
6 Nov 2026 at 00:11 HKT · updated 6 Nov, 04:25 · 1 min read
Hong Kong police will add artificial intelligence facial recognition to their 'Sharp Eye' CCTV system this month, with all 60,000 cameras across the city expected to be equipped with the function by 2028. Senior officers said the technology would not be used simultaneously on every camera due to computing power constraints.
Police said tests of the facial recognition function have already proven successful. In one case, officers located an 80-year-old man with dementia within about 90 minutes of receiving a report. In another instance, the system identified a robbery suspect's facial features and detected his movements after the crime, leading to an arrest.
Senior Superintendent Leung Ming-leung of the Force Operations Department described the introduction of facial recognition as equivalent to having additional officers working around the clock to monitor CCTV feeds for missing persons and suspicious individuals. He said the technology would speed up investigations and reduce the need for officers to manually review large amounts of footage, allowing more personnel to be deployed to other duties.
Leung said the facial recognition technology is accurate and a mature, reliable investigative tool already used by law enforcement agencies in mainland China and overseas. To protect personal data and privacy, the system requires authorisation before use, with applications made by specially trained personnel and approved by officers of inspector rank or above. After use, a review will be conducted.
As of the end of last month, the Sharp Eye programme had helped solve 2,192 criminal cases. Leung said that due to cost and legal requirements, images will not be stored for more than 31 days, while facial recognition data will be retained for no longer than 180 days.

|巴基斯坦将一个中国政策带入其领空
巴基斯坦将一个中国政策带入其领空
有报道称，巴基斯坦上个月禁止两家台湾航空公司——其国有航空公司中华航空公司和私营航空公司长荣航空公司——在其领空过境，这引发了人们对伊斯兰堡对“一个中国”政策的解释以及北京对其决策的影响程度的质疑。巴基斯坦国防部长卡瓦贾·阿西夫表示（在新窗口中打开）：“航空部门遵循一个中国政策，只允许中国大陆进入。”鉴于即使中国大陆也不对台湾商业航空公司实施此类限制，这一举措就显得更加不寻常。
该禁令突然被撤销，两家航空公司均获准在 2027 年 3 月 27 日之前进入巴基斯坦领空。然而，这只是临时安排，对于截止日期后会发生什么没有给出任何解释。
鉴于即使中国大陆也不对台湾商业航空公司实施此类限制，这一举措就显得更加不寻常。
巴基斯坦和台湾几乎没有实质性联系。伊斯兰堡严格奉行一个中国政策，与中国保持“铁杆友谊”。巴基斯坦与台湾的联系有限，居住在那里的巴基斯坦国民 (在新窗口中打开) 仅有 900 多名，其中包括学生、餐馆老板和其他专业人士。没有代表处，也从来没有设立过。两国之间也没有直航航班。南亚与台湾之间唯一的空中航线是台北至德里航线 (Opens in new window)，计划于 12 月 1 日恢复。
这项禁令超出了巴基斯坦遵守一个中国政策的通常要求。伊斯兰堡是其最坚定的追随者之一，定期重申（在新窗口中打开）其承诺并无条件支持中国的主权和领土完整，包括其在台湾问题上的立场。冒着使复杂问题简单化的风险，像巴基斯坦那样严格遵守，通常意味着反对台湾独立，接受北京关于台湾是中国一部分的主张，并且不与台北保持官方关系。然而，各国对政策的解释不同（在新窗口中打开）。一些坚持它的人仍然在台湾保持着贸易联系和非官方办事处。该政策并不意味着各国拒绝允许台湾商业航空公司过境其领空。这种许可是民航安排的问题。
各国以政治理由限制台湾航班。今年4月，塞舌尔、毛里求斯和马达加斯加撤回了台湾现任总统赖清德计划前往台湾在非洲仅存的外交盟友斯威士兰的飞越许可。但是，限制总统飞行是一个整体

Pakistan takes the One China policy into its airspace
A brief airspace restriction reveals how far Pakistan will go to reassure Beijing over Taiwan.

|Pakistan takes the One China policy into its airspace
Pakistan takes the One China policy into its airspace
Reports that Pakistan had last month barred two Taiwanese airlines, its state carrier China Airlines and private carrier EVA Air, from transiting through its airspace raised questions about Islamabad’s interpretation of the One China policy and the extent of Beijing’s influence over its decisions. Pakistan’s Defence Minister Khawaja Asif said (Opens in new window), “The aviation division follows the One China policy, only mainland China is allowed.” The move was all the more unusual given that even China does not impose such restrictions on Taiwanese commercial airlines.
The ban was abruptly reversed, with both airlines granted access to Pakistani airspace until 27 March 2027. This is only a temporary arrangement, however, and no explanation has been given about what happens after the deadline.
The move was all the more unusual given that even China does not impose such restrictions on Taiwanese commercial airlines.
Pakistan and Taiwan have few substantive ties. Islamabad strictly adheres to the One China policy and maintains an “ironclad friendship” with China. Pakistan’s limited links with Taiwan include just over 900 Pakistani nationals (Opens in new window) living there, including students, restaurant owners and other professionals. There is no representative office, nor has there ever been one. There are also no direct flights between the two sides. The only air connection between South Asia and Taiwan is the Taipei–Delhi route (Opens in new window), which is scheduled to resume on 1 December.
The ban goes beyond what Pakistan’s adherence to the One China policy would normally require. Islamabad is among its strongest adherents, regularly reaffirming (Opens in new window) its commitment and unconditionally supporting China’s sovereignty and territorial integrity, including its position on Taiwan. At the risk of simplifying a complex issue, a strict adherence, like that of Pakistan’s, generally means opposing Taiwan’s independence, accepting Beijing’s claim that Taiwan is part of China, and not maintaining official ties with Taipei. However, countries interpret (Opens in new window) the policy differently. Some that adhere to it still maintain trade ties and unofficial offices in Taiwan. The policy does not entail that countries deny Taiwanese commercial airlines permission to transit through their airspace. Such permission is a matter of civil aviation arrangements.
Countries have restricted Taiwanese flights on political grounds. In April this year, Seychelles, Mauritius and Madagascar withdrew overflight permissions (Opens in new window) for Taiwan’s incumbent President Lai Ching-te’s planned trip to Eswatini, Taiwan’s only remaining diplomatic ally in Africa. But, restricting a presidential flight is an entirely different issue from denying overflight rights to commercial airlines.
China Airlines flight from Taipei, 19 October 2026 (cifraser1/Flickr)
So, what could have prompted the decision? Was it an extension of China’s grey-zone activities (Opens in new window), or a show of loyalty arising from the China-Pakistan all-weather friendship?
There are two possible explanations for Pakistan’s decision. The first is that China asked Pakistan to impose the ban to reinforce the One China policy, discourage international engagement with Taiwan and demonstrate Beijing’s influence over its partners. Pakistan remains one of China’s most reliable supporters of its position on Taiwan.
The second possibility is that Pakistan imposed the ban on its own initiative to show its loyalty to China, particularly at a time when it is seeking closer ties with the United States. The Mecca Pact may have added to Islamabad’s incentive to reassure Beijing. Meanwhile, the China-Pakistan Economic Corridor, a flagship component of the Belt and Road Initiative, has become a security liability (Opens in new window) rather than a strategic and economic asset for Beijing. Against this backdrop, the ban may have been a token gesture to show that Pakistan’s efforts to move closer to Washington have not come at the expense of its relationship with China. Although overflight permissions have since been restored, at least for the time being, the message to Beijing is already delivered.
Pakistani airspace is useful for Taiwanese flights travelling to Middle East and Europe. If there is a renewed ban after the March 2027 deadline, it may not have major long-term implications for Taiwan, but rerouting would add to the duration and cost of operating these routes. The episode is also a reminder that Pakistan wants to remain useful to China and is willing to demonstrate that usefulness through decisions affecting Taiwan.
The greater concern is whether this sets a precedent. China could use similar pressure to influence other countries that are close to Beijing and strongly adhere to the One China policy, creating problems for Taiwanese airlines, particularly given Taipei’s lack of representation in the International Civil Aviation Organisation (ICAO). Restrictions on commercial aviation can potentially become another means of exerting pressure on Taiwan.
The decision is further evidence of China’s already formidable influence over Pakistan and Islamabad’s willingness to go further in demonstrating its loyalty to Beijing. But it does little for Pakistan. Applying the One China policy to commercial aviation imposes a restriction with little benefit beyond political signalling. More problematic is Pakistan’s readiness to extend its interpretation of the policy into areas not traditionally associated with it, adding new dimensions to and further complicating an already complex issue.
Sana Hashmi, PhD, is a fellow at the Taiwan-Asia Exchange Foundation. Views are personal.

content:
封面图：国民党蒋万安（左）、民进党沈伯洋（右）。 （资料来源：英联邦杂志） 台湾即将于 2026 年 11 月 28 日星期六举行“九合一”地方选举。虽然总统赖清德没有参加投票，但这次选举将成为台湾选民对国民党和民进党评价的首次重大选举考验。自2025年“大罢免”以来，“民主进步党”在不同城市进行选举，台北市长竞选可以说是两大政党之间最突出、最关键的战场。本分析旨在于 10 月 31 日两位候选人之间的正式政策辩论之前，提供 2026 年台北市长竞选的两大竞选背景。 台北市长选举的历史意义 台北市长选举一直备受关注，不仅因为台北作为台湾省会城市的地位，还因为这场竞选在国家层面的政治影响。历史上，台北市长竞选的候选人经常成为台湾总统选举的候选人。因此，今年的台北市长竞选被预计为“2028总统大选的开场小战”（2028总统大选的前哨战）。
表：选定的台北市长候选人和随后的政治角色。政治人物 党派 竞选台北市长年份 竞选总统年份 其他重要职务 陈水扁 民进党 1994 年（当选） 1998 年（落选） 2000 年（当选） 2004 年（当选） 民进党主席（2002-2004 年； 2007-2008) 马英九 国民党 1998 (当选) 2002 (当选) 2008 (当选) 2012 (当选) 国民党主席 (2005-2007; 2009-2014) 郝龙斌 国民党 2006 (当选) 2010 (当选) N/A 国民党副主席 (2014-2020) 谢长廷 民进党 2006 (落选) 2008 (落选) 民进党主席 (2000-2002) 驻日本大使 (2016-2024) 苏贞昌 民进党 2010 (落选) 2008 (落选) 民进党主席 (2005-2008; 2012-2014) 行政院院长 (2006-2007; 2019-2023) 柯文哲 (TPP, 台湾民众党) 2014 (当选) 2018 (当选) 2024 (落选) TPP 主席 (2019-2025) Sean Lien (连胜文) 国民党 2014 (遗失) N/A 国民党副主席 (2021-2025) (资料来源：作者编译)。左图：1994年竞选台北市长的民进党陈水扁（资料来源：BBC中文）。 /右图：时任国民党台北市市长马英九在 2006 年台北马拉松赛上发表讲话（来源：Wikimedia Commons）。随后，两人都利用台北市长的任期成功竞选总统。 “蓝北绿南”台北几十年来一直被广泛认为是国民党的据点，几乎没有例外。
自1994年台湾首次地方直选以来，台北市只选出了两位非国民党市长：1994年民进党的陈水扁；1994年当选的民进党陈水扁；以及2014年和2018年独立的柯文哲。就陈的情况而言，民主运动的势头很可能促成了他的胜利。 （1994年竞选中的另外两名候选人也平分了泛蓝选票。）然而，尽管陈水扁的市长职位满意度高达70%，但他在1998年的连任竞选中输给了马英九。这说明国民党在民意上仍然有稳固的支持基础。

【原文 English Original】
Cover i mage: Chiang Wan-an (蔣萬安) of KMT (left) and Puma Shen (沈伯洋) of DPP (right). (Source: Commonwealth Magazine ) Taiwan is fast approaching its “Nine-in-One” local elections, which will be held on Saturday, November 28, 2026. While President Lai Ching-te ( 賴清德 ) is not on the ballot, the election will serve as the first significant electoral test of Taiwanese voters’ assessments of the Kuomintang Party (KMT, 中國國民黨) and Democratic Progressive Party (DPP, 民主進步黨) since the “Great Recall Movement” (大罷免) in 2025. With elections taking place across different municipalities, the race for the Taipei mayor’s office is arguably the most prominent and critical battleground between the two major political parties. This analysis aims to provide background context regarding the two major campaigns competing in the 2026 Taipei mayoral race, prior to the official policy debate between the two candidates on October 31. Historical Significance of the Taipei Mayoral Election The Taipei mayoral election has always drawn a great amount of attention—not only by virtue of Taipei’s status as the capital city of Taiwan, but also because of the political implications of the race at the national level. Historically, candidates from Taipei mayoral races have often proceeded to become candidates in Taiwan’s presidential elections. Therefore, the race for Taipei mayor this year has been expected to be the “opening skirmish of the 2028 presidential election” (2028總統大選的前哨戰) . Table: Selected Taipei Mayoral Candidates and Subsequent Political Roles. Politicians Party Year of Running for Taipei Mayor Year of Running for President Other Notable Positions Chen Shui-bian (陳水扁) DPP 1994 (Elected) 1998 (Lost) 2000 (Elected) 2004 (Elected) DPP Chairperson (2002-2004; 2007-2008) Ma Ying-jeou (馬英九) KMT 1998 (Elected) 2002 (Elected) 2008 (Elected) 2012 (Elected) KMT Chairperson (2005-2007; 2009-2014) Hau Lung-pin (郝龍斌) KMT 2006 (Elected) 2010 (Elected) N/A KMT Deputy Chairperson (2014-2020) Hsieh Chang-ting (謝長廷) DPP 2006 (Lost) 2008 (Lost) DPP Chairperson (2000-2002) Ambassador to Japan (2016-2024) Su Tseng-chang (蘇貞昌) DPP 2010 (Lost) 2008 (Lost) DPP Chairperson (2005-2008; 2012-2014) Premier of Executive Yuan (2006-2007; 2019-2023) Ko Wen-je (柯文哲) Taiwan People’s Party (TPP, 台灣民眾黨) 2014 (Elected) 2018 (Elected) 2024 (Lost) TPP Chairperson (2019-2025) Sean Lien (連勝文) KMT 2014 (Lost) N/A KMT Deputy Chairperson (2021-2025) (Source: Compiled by the authors). Image left: Chen Shui-bian (陳水扁) of the DPP campaigning for Taipei mayor in 1994 (Source: BBC Zhongwen ). / Image right: Then-Taipei mayor Ma Ying-jeou ( 馬英九 ) of the KMT speaking at the Taipei Marathon in 2006 (Source: Wikimedia Commons ). Both men were subsequently able to leverage their tenure as Taipei mayors in successful bids for the presidency. “Blue North and Green South” Taipei has been widely considered a KMT stronghold for many decades, with few exceptions. Since Taiwan’s first direct local election took place in 1994, Taipei has only elected two non-KMT mayors: Chen Shui-bian (陳水扁) of the DPP in 1994; and then-independent Ko Wen-je (柯文哲) in 2014 and 2018. In Chen’s case, the momentum of pro-democracy movements likely contributed to his victory. (The other two candidates in the 1994 race also split the Pan-Blue vote .) Yet, despite a 70 percent satisfaction rate for Chen’s mayorship, he lost to Ma Ying-jeou (馬英九) in his 1998 bid for re-election. This demonstrates that the KMT still enjoys a solid support base in Taipei —due in part to the legacy of KMT military veterans and supporters settling in the capital city after the KMT retreat from mainland China in 1949. Entering the 2000s, both economic developments and turbulent cross-Strait relations led to the phenomenon of the “blue north and green south” (藍北綠南) in Taiwan politics. The KMT, because of its endorsement of closer cross-Strait ties, received greater support from the northern part of Taiwan, where technological and export-oriented industry thrived. The DPP, on the other hand, attracted a larger share of voters from southern Taiwan, partially as a result of its policies of benefiting farmers and closing up developmental gaps. In the past 10 years, Taiwan’s local elections have been significantly shaped by a range of factors, to include party influence, the charisma of individual candidates, and the prevailing political landscape. In addition, Taipei has witnessed a surge in independent voters who are indifferent to either major party. Ko successfully appealed to these independent voters, and won the Taipei mayoral elections twice as a political outsider in the 2010s. Undoubtedly, independent voters will still continue to play a critical role in deciding whether or not Taipei will elect another non-KMT mayor. The KMT and DPP Candidates in the 2026 Taipei Mayoral Election Five candidates are currently in the running in the Taipei mayoral race this year, with Chiang Wan-an (蔣萬安) of the KMT and Puma Shen (沈伯洋) of the DPP at the center of the spotlight. The parallels and contrasts between the two candidates have dominated most election-related headlines and social media discussions. Both Chiang and Shen grew up in Taipei and went on to pursue higher education in the United States. (Chiang received his JD from the University of Pennsylvania in 2006; Shen earned his PhD in criminology and sociology from the University of California, Irvine in 2017.) They also share similar public images of being both family men and rising stars within their respective parties’ younger generation. Still, differences between Chiang and Shen are salient. Chiang enjoys the advantages of being the incumbent seeking re-election, as well as the “Chiang-family” prestige from being a rumored descendant of Chiang Kai-shek (although this claim has its own set of controversies ). Shen, with his professional experience primarily focused on national defense and information warfare in academia, is often criticized for lacking formal political experience and lineage. While he joined the DPP only three years ago, he has gained significant status and visibility within the party during that time. Regardless of the election outcome, Shen’s status could further rise due to his willingness to take on a risk that no one else in the DPP was willing to bear: potentially losing another election in the capital city to the opposing party. Images: Chiang Wan-an (蔣萬安) of the KMT (left) and Puma Shen (沈伯洋) of the DPP (right). (Source: CNA ) Where the Candidates Stand in Current Polls When Shen made the decision to run as the DPP candidate for Taipei mayor in May, the public widely viewed it as a “ battle without any chance of winning .” In an opinion poll conducted by TVBS Poll Center in May 2026, 58 percent of respondents supported Chiang for re-election, while only 30 percent of respondents preferred Shen to be their mayor. However, five months of campaigning have significantly altered the popularity of the two candidates. The newest poll in October 2026 also carried out by TVBS shows that the support rate for Chiang has dropped to 49 percent, as that of Shen has risen to 41 percent. An opinion poll by another survey center has demonstrated a more dramatic shift: 50 percent of respondents believed that Shen is more suitable for the mayorship, leaving only 33 percent supporting Chiang. Nevertheless, whether or not opinion polls accurately reflect public opinion is still up for debate. Considering the unexpected failure of the Great Recall Movement , DPP supporters remain cautiously optimistic about Shen’s chance of victory. During the recall movement, the narrative of “countering China to protect Taiwan” (抗中保台) promoted by pro-DPP voters failed to attract independent voters, who were more concerned about economic and social issues. The results of the Great Recall Movement severely damaged morale within the DPP, and subsequently boosted the KMT’s status. Despite a promising support rate in recent polls, it still remains a challenge for the DPP to “break” the “spiral of silence” effect (沉默螺旋) among Taipei constituents – which in this context means the assumption that most KMT voters restrain from expressing their support for the KMT publicly due to fear of judgement from peers or society, although they would still ultimately cast ballots in favor of the KMT. It is also worth observing whether or not Taipei voters will approve of the DPP’s attempts to strike a balance between its core values of national security, and local issues that may appear less abstract to independent voters. National Security Concerns and Foreign Interference in Local Elections Taiwan’s presidential elections have been targeted by foreign influence campaigns , and this fact has been widely discussed. However, local elections in recent years have also been subject to foreign interference, and China has explicitly attempted to interfere in the 2026 Taipei mayoral race. The Global Times (环球时报), a Chinese Communist Party (CCP)-affiliated media outlet, published an article on October 27 criticizing the DPP for allegedly “shaping the election with underground gambling.” Furthermore, Taiwan’s National Security Bureau (NSB, 國家安全局) recently revealed that the Government Service Network (GSN, 政府網路服務網)—which is a dedicated and secure high-speed backbone network for Taiwanese government agencies to use for internet usage and cybersecurity defense – had been attacked on average 2.58 million times per day, and that the number of attacks have risen as this year’s election approaches. The NSB stated that the increase of interference could reflect preparation for intelligence collection and influence campaigns directed against the upcoming local elections. Social media has become a double-edged sword in Taiwan’s elections, and the upcoming Taipei mayoral election is not an exception. Both candidates and their supporters have been actively engaging with each other on social media outlets such as Threads and Facebook . The interactive nature of social media has increased the public discussion on policy and politics. However, it has also been exploited to advance foreign influence campaigns against Taiwan’s elections, including races for local mayors and legislators. Around the 2022 local elections, Taiwan’s Doublethink Lab observed a surge of suspicious posts with misinformation and extreme narratives attacking DPP-affiliated politicians. With the growing popularity of Threads among the Taiwanese audience, especially among the younger generation, inauthentic social media posts have only become more rampant this year. For example, a series of opinion polls on the special municipalities conducted by the “Chiaohu Island Poll” (巧虎島民調) have circulated on Facebook and Threads; however, it appears that no such company actually exists, as there is no entity by that name registered with the Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA, 經濟部). The “Chiaohu Island” graphics also show no information on the methodology of how these “polls” were conducted (such as the sampling size, actual questionnaires used, etc.). In addition, a series of posts have circulated on the internet attacking Shen for allegedly making up false stories of his grandfather and other issues. These posts have aimed to frame Shen as dishonest, thereby impacting voters’ opinions to be unfavorable towards Shen. As Shen has been listed as a “ die-hard Taiwan independent separatist” (台獨頑固分子) by China’s Taiwan Affairs Office (TAO, 國務院台灣事務辦公室), it may be expected that foreign interference will only further intensify as the elections approach. The “Kevin Tsai Incident” and Financial Coercion A recent case of foreign coercion targeting Taiwan’s local elections that has recently emerged in news headlines is China’s reaction to Kevin Tsai (蔡康永)’s participation in Shen’s campaign . Tsai, the popular and well-known host of the popular Taiwanese variety show Kangsi Coming (康熙來了), was photographed in October while attending a Shen campaign event. Unsurprisingly, Tsai’s presence stirred up considerable negative reactions from China . Tsai’s social media accounts were flooded with raging Chinese netizens. Companies that previously cooperated with Tsai, such as Leapmotor and Harper’s Bazaar China, announced that they would take down any related advertisement contents. Moreover, Chinese officials and CCP-affiliated organizations have also weighed in on the incident. The TAO criticized Tsai of being a “two-faced” person who “earns Chinese money while entangling with Taiwan independence forces.” A social media account affiliated with the PLA News Media Center threatened that public figures will pay the price for siding with pro-“Taiwan independence” figures. Image: Famous television host Kevin Tsai (蔡康永) was seen participating in Shen’s campaigning event on October 4. (Source: CNA ) The immense pressure from China forced Tsai to put out a formal statement that he does not support independence. The TAO then responded to Tsai’s social media post by calling on Taiwanese celebrities to nurture Chinese “compatriotship” and promote friendly cross-Strait interactions. Taiwan’s Mainland Affairs Office (大陸委員會) warned that this has become a strategy of the CCP: coercing public figures to take a stand, then demanding pledges that they behave in accordance with CCP positions. This type of behavior reminded many voters of a similar incident involving the K-pop star, Chou Tzu-Yu (周子瑜) , close to the 2016 presidential elections—an event that many believed shifted some voters’ behaviors to vote for Tsai Ing-Wen. Whether the Kevin Tsai incident and similar actions from the CCP will convert Taiwanese peoples’ actual voting behavior still remains to be seen, but it is clear from all the online discussions and media frenzy around such incidents that many people are watching this election closely. The main point : Both the KMT and the DPP have a large stake in the upcoming Taipei mayoral election, as it could impact the future political trajectory for both parties on a national level. The KMT incumbent, Chiang Wan-an, was initially viewed as a strong favorite to win re-election; however, the DPP challenger, Puma Shen, has proven to be an effective campaigner and has outperformed initial expectations. Intensive campaigning from both sides may be expected in the lead-up to the election on November 28. The post Battle for the Capital: Inside the 2026 Taipei Mayoral Race, Part 1 appeared first on Global Taiwan Institute .

summary: 朝中社图片 俄罗斯和朝鲜本周进行了弹道导弹发射，根据俄罗斯国防部周三发布的消息，俄罗斯从西太平洋向俄罗斯北极地区发射了潜射弹道导弹（SLBM），而朝鲜则发射了短程弹道导弹（SRBM），作为朝鲜领导人金正恩在无人机技术展览期间进行火力演示的一部分。核动力弹道导弹潜艇 (SSBN) RFS Generalissimus Suvorov (K-553)，分配给
content:
朝中社图片 俄罗斯和朝鲜本周进行了弹道导弹发射，根据俄罗斯国防部周三发布的消息，俄罗斯从西太平洋向俄罗斯北极地区发射了潜射弹道导弹（SLBM），而朝鲜则发射了短程弹道导弹（SRBM），作为朝鲜领导人金正恩在无人机技术展览期间进行火力演示的一部分。隶属于俄罗斯海军太平洋舰队的核动力弹道导弹潜艇（SSBN）RFS Generalissimus Suvorov（K-553）在俄罗斯西北部阿尔汉格尔斯克地区的奇扎试验场从鄂霍次克海发射了一枚RSM-56“布拉瓦”潜射弹道导弹。俄罗斯国防部周三表示：“苏沃洛夫大元帅号战略核动力弹道导弹潜艇按照作战训练计划发射了布拉瓦洲际弹道导弹。”导弹从水下位置发射，导弹弹头在预计时间成功到达指定区域。俄罗斯国防部还发布了官方媒体塔斯社转载的发射视频。尽管针对 10 月 25 日至 31 日期间进行的导弹活动发出了国际航行警告，但俄罗斯国防部并未说明发射时间。
据美国海军学院新闻报道，俄罗斯在 10 月至 11 月期间定期从俄罗斯远东地区进行潜射弹道导弹发射，苏沃洛夫大元帅于 2022 年 11 月 3 日发射了“布拉瓦”导弹，并于当年 12 月 29 日投入使用。俄罗斯上一次通过弹道导弹核潜艇发射潜射弹道导弹是在今年 5 月 21 日，当时一艘水下的 Delta IV 级弹道导弹核潜艇发射了一枚 R-29RMU Sineva 潜射弹道导弹，作为其战略核力量演习的一部分。今年仅公开披露过两次潜射弹道导弹发射，中国于 7 月从南海向南太平洋发射了一次潜射弹道导弹，法国于 10 月初进行了一次发射，从法国菲尼斯泰尔海岸向北大西洋偏远地区发射了一枚潜射弹道导弹。与俄罗斯的潜射弹道导弹在本国领土着陆和法国的潜射弹道导弹在距海岸线数百公里的北大西洋着陆不同，中国因将该地区用作潜射弹道导弹试验场而受到南太平洋岛国和其他国家的批评。朝鲜周四发射了 KN-25 600 毫米多管火箭弹（属于短程弹道导弹），作为朝鲜领导人金正恩出席的无人机技术展览期间火力演示的一部分。韩国参谋长联席会议周四表示，朝鲜于中午 12 点 30 分从元山向日本海发射了 10 枚短程弹道导弹（SRBM）。当地时间，联合参谋长联席会议还表示，短程弹道导弹的飞行距离为250公里。
日本防卫省周四报道称，朝鲜当天中午12点36分发射了一枚弹道导弹，估计弹道导弹落在朝鲜半岛东海岸附近。 JSC 和 MOD 均表示，美国、日本和韩国正在共享信息并分析此次发射。与此同时，美国太平洋司令部在声明中称发射的弹道导弹数量为两枚。周五，官方媒体朝中社报道称，金正恩周四参观了“2026年无人机技术发展”展览，该展览展示了朝鲜的无人机能力

【原文 English Original】
KCNA image Russia and North Korea carried out ballistic missile launches this week with Russia conducting a launch of a Submarine-Launched Ballistic Missile (SLBM) from the Western Pacific to Russia arctic region, according to a Russian Ministry of Defence (MOD) release on Wednesday while North Korea carried out launches of Short-Range Ballistic Missiles (SRBMs) as part of a firepower demonstration for North Korea leader Kim Jong Un during an exhibition of unmanned aerial vehicle technology. Nuclear powered ballistic missile submarine (SSBN) RFS Generalissimus Suvorov (K-553), assigned to the Russian Navy Pacific Fleet, launched a RSM-56 Bulava SLBM from the sea of Okhotsk at the Chizha test site in the Arkhangelsk region of northwest Russia. “The strategic nuclear-powered ballistic missile submarine Generalissimus Suvorov launched a Bulava intercontinental ballistic missile in accordance with the combat training plan,”the Russian MOD said on Wednesday. The missiles were fired from a submerged position and the missile’s warheads successfully reached the designated area at the estimated time. The Russian MOD also released a video of the launch that was carried by state media TASS. The Russian MOD did not state when the launch took place though international navigational warnings were issued on missile activity being carried out from Oct. 25-31. Russia has regularly carried out SLBM launches from the Russian Far East during the October to November with Generalissimus Suvorov firing a Bulava on Nov. 3 2022 prior to being commissioned on Dec. 29 that year, reported USNI News. Russia last carried out an SLBM launch by a SSBN on May 21 this year when a submerged Delta IV class SSBN launched an R-29RMU Sineva SLBM as part of an exercise of its strategic nuclear forces. There has been only two other publicly disclosed SLBM launches this year, with China carrying out a launch in July from the South China Sea into the South Pacific and France carrying out one in early October , launching an SLBM from off the coast of Finistère, France into a remote area of the North Atlantic. Unlike Russia, where the SLBM landed in national territory and France, where it landed in the North Atlantic, several hundred kilometers from any coastline, China was criticised by South Pacific island states and other countries for using the area as an SLBM test site. North Korea on Thursday conducted firings of its KN-25 600mm multiple launch rockets, which are classed as SRBMs, as part of a firepower demonstration during an exhibition of UAV technology that was attended by North Korea leader Kim Jong Un. South Korea’s Joint Chiefs of Staff on Thursday stated that North Korea launched 10 short range ballistic missiles (SRBMs) from Wonsan into the Sea of Japan at 12.30 p.m. local time, the JCS also said the SRBMs flew for a distance of 250km. Japan’s Ministry of Defense (MOD) reported on Thursday that North Korea launched a ballistic missile at 12.36 p.m. that day and it was estimated that the ballistic missile landed near the east coast of the Korean Peninsula. Both the JSC and MOD stated that the U.S., Japan and South Korea were sharing information and analysing the launches. U.S. Pacific Command’s meanwhile placed the number of ballistic missiles launched at two in its statement . On Friday, state media Korean Central News Agency reported that Kim visited the Unmanned Aeronautical Technology Development-2026 exhibition on Thursday, which showcase North Korea’s UAV capabilities and advancements. KCNA did not state the location of the exhibition though it was likely in Wonsan given the SRBM launches from the area on Thursday matched what was fired during the firepower demonstration. In his speech at the exhibition, Kim called on North Korea to seize absolute superiority in drone technology and urged North Korean scientists to go all out in obtaining miraculous results in research on UAV and Artificial Intelligence (AI) for national defence. After touring the exhibition, the North Korean leader witnessed a firepower demonstration that involved strikes on islet target by various tactical suicide attack drones, tactical cruise missiles, multi-purpose drones and a 600mm-calibre Multiple Rocket Launcher (MRL) battalion. KCNA also reported that the demonstration also involved the first publicly displayed firing of a 600mm-calibre ultra-precision MRL called ‘Sniper’. The rockets fired by North Korea’s KN-25 MRL are classed as SRBMs and North Korea has claimed they can be fitter with nuclear warheads. Imagery by KCNA, showed salvo firings by a dozen launchers. KCNA also released images showing UAVs launching missiles and loitering munitions hitting targets with some of the targets made to look like South Korean outpost and K9 Thunder Self-Propelled Howitzers and U.S. M1 Abrams tanks. KCNA images also showed Kim looking at racks of First Person View (FPV) Small Unmanned Aerial Systems (SUASs) and a new flying wing stealth design UAV not previously seen. The state media did not report or provided any details on the UAVs shown. It is unclear as to whether the flying wing UAV was an operational UAV or a model representing an actual in service UAV or one under development.

content:
﻿ 以下是上周西太平洋主要舰船活动和演习的摘要。日本周边加拿大皇家海军水兵游览尼米兹级航空母舰西奥多·罗斯福号 (CVN-71)，在演习“利剑”(KS27) 期间与哈利法克斯级护卫舰 HMCS Regina (FFH 334) 进行乘客交换，2026 年 10 月 26 日。美国海军照片 航空母舰西奥多·罗斯福号 (CVN-71) 周一与加拿大皇家海军进行乘客交换HMCS Regina (FFH 334) 护卫舰在进行“利剑 27”(KS27) 演习。美日双边“利刃27”演习于10月19日开始，于周四结束，大部分活动在日本西南部地区进行。西奥多·罗斯福号航母打击群由西奥多·罗斯福号航空母舰和第 11 舰载机联队 (CVW)、巡洋舰长津号 (CG-65) 以及驱逐舰保罗·汉密尔顿号 (DDG-60) 和迪凯特号 (DDG-73) 组成。 2026 年 10 月 24 日，美国海军水手长莱拉·林 (Layla Lam) 被分配到尼米兹级航空母舰西奥多·罗斯福号 (CVN-71) 号航母上，与亨利·J·凯撒级舰队补给加油船 USNS Tippecanoe (T-AO 199) 一起进行海上补给。美国海军照片周六早些时候，西奥多·罗斯福携带作为演习的一部分，美国海军蒂佩卡诺号舰队加油船 (T-AO-199) 进行海上补给。虽然是美国和日本之间的双边演习，但伙伴国家也被邀请参加。
大约 45,000 名日本自卫队成员、11,000 名美国军人以及来自澳大利亚、加拿大、法国、德国、荷兰、新西兰和菲律宾的数量不详的部队以及来自韩国和英国的观察员参加了此次活动。 2026 年 10 月 25 日，美国海军陆战队与第 12 濒海战斗队、第 12 海军陆战团、第 3 师濒海战斗队在日本陆上自卫队 Hijudai 机动区举行的“锐剑 27”演习中准备出发前往部队进行训练。美国海军陆战队照片 共有 260 架飞机和 40 艘舰艇，其中包括西奥多·罗斯福号演习中部署了CSG。演习活动包括周日第 12 海军陆战队濒海团 (MLR) 和日本陆上自卫队在九州自卫队 Hijudai 机动区进行的武力演习，周一远征作战训练大队和第 3 海军陆战师第 3 侦察营在冲绳的海上行动，以及第 3 登陆支援营、第 3 海上后勤大队和第 3 海军陆战队后勤大队在冲绳的双边护航行动。日本陆上自卫队周一。台湾国家安全委员会秘书长吴钊燮发布的一张图片显示，截至周三，辽宁舰航母战斗群正在菲律宾主岛吕宋岛以东的菲律宾海执行任务。
该打击群包括航空母舰辽宁号（16艘）、巡洋舰鞍山号（101艘）和无锡号（104艘）以及淮南号驱逐舰（123艘）。在日本横须贺，黄蜂级两栖攻击舰马金岛号（LHD-8）于2026年10月26日抵达日本横须贺舰队活动司令部。美国海军照片马金岛两栖准备大队于周一驶入横须贺舰队活动司令部（CFAY）进行维护和补给。该 ARG 包括两栖攻击舰马金岛号 (LHD-8)、两栖运输船坞号 USS 安克雷奇 (LPD-23) 和 USS 约翰·P·穆萨 (LPD-26) 以及已上船的第 13 海军陆战队远征队

Around Japan Royal Canadian Navy Sailors tour Nimitz-class aircraft carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt (CVN-71), during a passenger exchange with Halifax-class frigate HMCS Regina (FFH 334), during exercise Keen Sword (KS27), Oct. 26, 2026. The Theodore Roosevelt Carrier Strike Group consists of aircraft carrier Theodore Roosevelt with embarked carrier air wing (CVW) 11, cruiser USS Chosin (CG-65) and destroyers USS Paul Hamilton (DDG-60) and USS Decatur (DDG-73). U.S. Navy Boatswain’s Mate Seaman Layla Lam, assigned to Nimitz-class aircraft carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt (CVN-71), heaves around line during a replenishment-at-sea with Henry J. U.S. Marines with Alpha Company, 12th Littoral Combat Team, 12th Marine Littoral Regiment, 3rd Marine Division, prepare to depart for a force-on-force training operation during Exercise Keen Sword 27 at Japan Ground Self-Defense Force Hijudai Maneuver Area, Oct. 25, 2026. Exercise activities included force-on-force drills between 12th Marine Littoral Regiment (MLR) and the Japan Ground Self-Defense Force at JGSDF Hijudai Maneuver Area, Kyushu on Sunday , maritime operations in Okinawa by Expeditionary Operations Training Group and 3rd Reconnaissance Battalion, 3rd Marine Division on Monday and bilateral convoys operations in Okinawa between 3rd Landing Support Battalion, 3rd Marine Logistics Group and the JGSDF on Monday . In the Philippine Sea The Liaoning Carrier Strike Group is operating in the Philippine Sea east of the Philippine main island of Luzon as of Wednesday according to a graphic posted by Joseph Wu, Secretary General of Taiwan’s National Security Council. The strike group includes aircraft carrier CNS Liaoning (16) cruisers CNS Anshan (101) and CNS Wuxi (104) and destroyer CNS Huainan (123). In Yokosuka, Japan Wasp-class amphibious assault ship USS Makin Island (LHD-8) pulls in to Commander, Fleet Activities, Yokosuka, Japan, Oct. 26, 2026. US Navy photo The Makin Island Amphibious Ready Group pulled into Commander, Fleet Activities Yokosuka (CFAY) on Monday for maintenance and resupply. The ARG includes amphibious assault ship USS Makin Island (LHD-8), amphibious transport docks USS Anchorage (LPD-23) and USS John P. Murtha (LPD-26) and the embarked 13th Marine Expeditionary Unit (MEU). Cruiser USS Chosin (CG-65), part of the Theodore Roosevelt CSG pulled into CFAY on Sunday and departed on Wednesday , according to local ship spotters. Expeditionary fast transport USNS City of Bismarck (T-EPF-9) and Royal Australian Navy frigate HMAS Stuart (FFH153) docked into Yokosuka on Friday according to local ship spotters . In the Miyako Strait On Tuesday, a single Chinese Y-9 Electronic Intelligence (ELINT) aircraft flew in from the East China Sea and passed between Okinawa and Miyako Island to enter the Philippine Sea. The aircraft flew as far as south of Amami Oshima, then flew back to return to the East China Sea. Japan Air Self-Defense Force fighter aircraft of the Southwestern Air Defense Command were scrambled to intercept the Y-9. Also on Tuesday, People’s Liberation Army Navy cruiser CNS Lhasa (102) and fleet oiler CNS Kekexilihu (903) were sighted sailing southeast 140 kilometers – 87 miles – northeast of Miyako Island and subsequently sailed southeast between Okinawa and Miyako Island to enter the Philippine Sea. A JMSDF P-3C Orion Maritime Patrol Aircraft shadowed the PLAN ships. That same day, PLAN destroyer CNS Xining (117) and frigate CNS Yanchang (546) were spotted south 70 kilometers – 43 miles – west of Kume Island. On Thursday, a Chinese TB-001 reconnaissance UAV flew in from the East China Sea and over the waters between Miyako Island and Okinawa to enter the Philippine Sea. The drone then flew northeast and conducted a patrol circuit before returning back to the East China Sea the same way. Also on Thursday, a Y-9 MPA flew in from the East China Sea, and also passed over the waters between Miyako Island and Okinawa to enter the Philippine Sea. content:
据船舶建造经理周五发布的公告称，LST-100 韩华费城造船厂已赢得价值 2.69 亿美元的合同，用于建造海军陆战队中型登陆舰。 TOTE Services 在 7 月份赢得了价值 22 亿美元的合同，担任 LSM 船舶建造经理，并在 7 月份提出征求建议书后将合同授予韩华。 TOTE 新闻稿中写道：“韩华防务美国公司 (HDUSA) 是通过该流程选出的第一家造船商，因为其具有竞争力的定价以及对 TOTE Services 分包合同条款和条件的接受。” “该合同涵盖在韩华费城造船厂 (HPSI) 建造一艘价值 2.69 亿美元的 LSM，并可选择另外建造三艘船舶。”位于墨西哥湾沿岸的 Bollinger Shipyards 已签订建造第一艘 LSM 的合同。威斯康星州的 Fincantieri Marinette Marine 公司今年早些时候赢得了一份为四艘船提供长铅项目的合同。据该公司称，TOTE 的 LSM 合同涉及多达八艘船。新闻稿中写道：“TOTE Services 继续与 Bollinger Shipyards 和 Fincantieri Marinette Marine 进行富有成效的合同讨论，这两家船厂都根据 VCM 合同指导造船厂，预计将在建造 LSM 船队方面发挥有意义的作用。”这是海军第一次选择使用船舶建造经理来代表海军运行该计划。
USNI 新闻图片 由于海军和海军陆战队就该舰的设计和生存能力展开争论，LSM 项目多年来一直面临着需求波动。该平台是海军陆战队当前在西太平洋对抗中国战略的重要组成部分，较小的海军陆战队部队将在岛屿和海岸线之间移动，建立临时基地，从那里可以发射反舰导弹。 LSM基于Damen LST-100概念，这是一种出口导向型坦克登陆舰设计，目前在尼日利亚海军服役，也计划在澳大利亚皇家海军服役。据 USNI News 此前报道，海军以 1700 万美元的价格购买了该设计包。 TOTE 已经在管理韩华费城造船厂正在建造的另一个项目——美国海事管理局的国家安全多任务船只。去年，唐纳德·特朗普总统访问韩国后，白宫宣布了与韩国的贸易协议概要。该协议包括韩国承诺向美国造船业投资 1500 亿美元。

【原文 English Original】
LST-100 Hanwha Philly Shipyard has won a $269 million contract to build the Marine Corps’ Landing Ship Medium, according to a Friday announcement from the program’s vessel construction manager. TOTE Services, which won a $2.2 billion contract in July to function as the LSM vessel construction manager, awarded Hanwha the contract after putting out a request for proposals in July. “Hanwha Defense USA (HDUSA) is the first shipbuilder selected through that process, based on its competitive pricing and acceptance of TOTE Services’ subcontract terms and conditions,” reads a TOTE news release. “The award covers construction of one LSM, valued at $269 million, at Hanwha Philly Shipyard (HPSI), with options for three additional vessels.” Gulf Coast-based Bollinger Shipyards is already on contract to build the first LSM. Fincantieri Marinette Marine out of Wisconsin won a contract earlier this year for long lead items for four ships. TOTE’s LSM contract is for as many as eight ships, according to the company. “TOTE Services continues productive contract discussions with Bollinger Shipyards and Fincantieri Marinette Marine, both directed shipyards under the VCM contract, which are expected to play a meaningful role in building the LSM fleet,” reads the release. This is the first time the Navy has opted to use a vessel construction manager, which runs the program on behalf of the service. USNI News graphic The LSM program has faced years of requirements churn as the Navy and Marine Corps debated the ship’s design and survivability. The platform is a crucial component of the Marine Corps’ current strategy for countering China in the Western Pacific, where smaller units of Marines would move around between islands and shorelines to set up ad-hoc bases from which they could fire anti-ship missiles. The LSM is based on the Damen LST-100 concept, an export-oriented tank landing ship design currently in service with the Nigerian Navy and also planned for the Royal Australian Navy. The Navy bought the design package for $17 million, USNI News previously reported. TOTE is already managing another program under construction at Hanwha Philly Shipyard – the U.S. Maritime Administration’s National Security Multi-Mission Vessel. Last year, the White House announced the outlines of a trade deal with South Korea following President Donald Trump’s visit to the country. That deal included a pledge from South Korea to put $150 billion into American shipbuilding.

title: 同运须是群众抗争才能抵抗歧视席卷
source: 中国劳工论坛 China Worker
summary: 陈延年 国际社会主义道路 同婚合法化七年后，反同趋势不减反增。据政院民调，相较去年，今年同婚支持者减6.3%，跨性别者免术换证支持者减13.8%。这并非暂时下跌，而是反同威胁与日俱增的警钟。我们迫切需要建设战斗性的同运抗争，包含将同志游行变成组织起来的平台，才能动员最大的力量揭穿恐同势力的谎言，并且团结广大的劳动群众，共同对抗注定制造压迫、歧视与猎巫的资本主义。 全球右翼反扑 中共去年11月下架同志交友软体Blued与Finka，美国政府近年取消了跨性别身份的合法承认。土耳其
content: 陈延年 国际社会主义道路 同婚合法化七年后，反同趋势不减反增。据政院民调，相较去年，今年同婚支持者减6.3%，跨性别者免术换证支持者减13.8%。这并非暂时下跌，而是反同威胁与日俱增的警钟。我们迫切需要建设战斗性的同运抗争，包含将同志游行变成组织起来的平台，才能动员最大的力量揭穿恐同势力的谎言，并且团结广大的劳动群众，共同对抗注定制造压迫、歧视与猎巫的资本主义。 全球右翼反扑 中共去年11月下架同志交友软体Blued与Finka，美国政府近年取消了跨性别身份的合法承认。土耳其政府近期逮捕至少50名骄傲集会人士和记者，并将同志猎巫为生育率低迷原因。 今日台湾反同趋势是全球右翼攻击的一环，这一年来就有两家同志酒吧遭国家迫害，导致其中一间倒闭，另一间则发生在近期，源自蒋万安与绿营议员洪健益之间的恐同竞赛，保护虚构的「未成年少女」以行反同之实。 1997年常德街事件那种打压同志及LGBTQ+空间的手段席卷重来，事件后一名顾客回到酒吧受访表示：「我开始怀疑同志友善这件事是不是包装出来的。」这种令人失望的局势，可追溯自2017年，当时同运由下而上的动员力量迫使司法院做出倾向平权的解释，这股力量本可进一步组织起来，迫使民进党立刻实现同婚，并扫除至今仍被用来迫害同志酒吧的法律工具，主要性别NGO却将重点摆在依靠绿营政客立法，导致抗争随时间解散，随后便见证了2018反同公投，甚至近期警察迫害同志酒吧等恐同反扑。 此外，作为同志空间的公园近年也遭受日益严重的警察驱离，使基层同志、尤其无法自由转换雇主的移工，失去了一个个能在昏暗下的匿名地远离恐同生活圈的空间。 蓝绿急遽右转 酒吧事件爆发前夕，蒋万安称「禁止毒品进入校园社区」，随后蓝营政客们忙于把「美沙冬」戒毒辅助药物抹黑成「发放毒品」，利用群众对毒品的愤慨将自己打扮为「打毒悍将」博取支持，他们明知但故意加深了同志长年被与毒品挂钩的污名，这只会让所有本已受尽压抑与压迫的群体（例如过劳司机）更难脱离毒品控制。与此同时，绿营政客的右翼支持者们把反对警察打压同志酒吧的游行，当作分掉沈伯洋造势人数的敌视对象。我们在〈争取性别平等的斗争：为什么民进党并非站在我们这边〉曾指出：「蓝营充斥歧视偏见，而民进党也不民主进步，反而正在急遽右转，摆脱任何『进步』政策的残余，性平修辞被其视为累赘，其高层和政策对性别权利的态度，已使绿营也成为极端右翼的喧嚣新基地。」这显示所有资产阶级政党正急遽右转，争相诉诸歧视煽动来巩固权力，并与警察乃至整个国家机器中固有的恐同暴力结合。 右翼势力例如极右的台联党、反跨「No self ID」，利用了厕所、身份证、变性手术等议题来装扮为保护女性、儿童和家庭，借由攻击跨性别者来分化劳动阶级团结，并得到急于寻求保守群体支持的蓝绿白的纵容。实际上，这种的伎俩只是帮助老板阶级与官僚转移视线，让他们继续压迫劳工与学生组织工会和集体抗争的民主权利，而这正好是能够对抗职场歧视、性暴力与霸凌的关键力量。他们反对跨性别儿童变性的权利，只是让儿童继续承受性别不安的痛苦甚至因此自杀。 分化威胁剧增 全球资本主义体制正对跨性别者甚至整个LGBTQ+群体发动攻击，作为打击全体劳动阶级的破口。因此，跨性别议题不仅是涉及特殊身份压迫，更是检验更广泛的性别运动与工人斗争能否战胜资本主义更猛烈的猎巫攻势的关键考验。 排跨的分化威胁渗透到了同运内部，不只是排跨的「LGB联盟」，去年仍任职的同志游行公关主任甚至发表排跨言论，这是一个同运瘫痪的警号。 我们社会主义者坚定支持LGBTQ+群体的权利，包括跨性别者能按照认同取用到身份证、厕所与医疗服务（包括荷尔蒙与变性手术）的权利。我们认为同运团体们需要主动提出支持医疗公共化、广建社会住宅、降低工会组织门槛、增加失业救济金，这些诉求不仅连结到多数同志能按照认同生活的物质条件，也是用来阻止右翼趁机猎巫，让同运能赢得广泛劳动群众的支持的关键方向。 根据同志咨询热线2023年调查，不到30%的同志会在职场上向主管出柜；根据2020年伴侣盟调查，遭受职场霸凌的跨性别者有多达70%被迫只好「不处理」。没有理由认为在厌女恐同排跨全球席卷的今天，这些情况会有显著好转。财团为了在中国等同志权利更受打压的地区逐利，可以轻易收起他们在台湾同样为了逐利才假装挺同的面具，一旦恐同势力更占上风他们就会卸下彩虹旗。同运必须摆脱财团赞助的路线，大胆提出支持建设工会对抗职场歧视的诉求。■ 国际社会主义道路主张： 停止用罪责惩罚LGBTQ+，除罪化合意自主行为。 组织群众性同志运动，连结媒体及所有职场工会运动，共同对抗恐同偏见。 全体劳工共同抗争，反对一切右翼政策、歧视与压迫。 争取民主权利、住房、医疗保障，以及能维持生计的就业机会。 扩大组织战斗性的同运，不信财团与亲资蓝绿白的粉红漂洗。 這篇文章 同运须是群众抗争才能抵抗歧视席卷 最早出現於 中国劳工论坛 China Worker 。
