2021年3月2日，香港民主活動人士黃之鋒在西九龍法院出庭後，從懲教署的囚車走出荔枝角接待中心。 （圖片來源：Anthony Kwan／Getty Images） 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。
【看中国2026年11月6日讯】（看中国记者孟浩综合报道）香港国安法指定法官谭耀豪11月5日判处黄之锋监禁十年，罪名是串谋勾结外国势力。他已认罪，预计2036年才获释。法院称其呼吁外国制裁属罪行重大。《华尔街日报》、自由之家、欧盟、台湾陆委会、港加联及多个海外民运团体则纷纷谴责，认为判决把政治倡议入罪，并要求释放他。 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。
黄之锋被控2020年7月至11月间，与前党友罗冠聪等人串谋，请求外国或境外机构对香港或中国实施制裁、封锁或其他敌对行动。他5月在裁判法院认罪，9月2日在高等法院再次认罪。法官认为，他与罗冠聪同属本案主脑，且国安法实施后仍持续呼吁外国制裁，属罪行重大。
法官以13年为量刑起点，因认罪等因素扣减至10年，部分刑期与“35+”颠覆案同期执行。按国安法，罪行重大可判十年以上至终身监禁。辩方指，黄之锋犯案时只有23岁，行为集中在2020年7月，案件拖延检控，令刑期无法与颠覆案同期执行。
黄之锋2020年11月起还押，2024年因民主派初选案被判四年八个月，原定明年1月出狱。新判决令他预计到2036年才获释，届时已40岁。
《华尔街日报》编辑委员会社论称，黄之锋自14岁起公开反对北京收紧香港自由，如今将被当作政治犯关到40岁，他真正的“罪行”是呼吁国际社会关注中国违反《中英联合声明》。社论指，黎智英同样因勾结外国势力被判监20年，国安案定罪率接近100%。
社论也点出反差：同一周，香港举办全球投资高峰会，多家华尔街银行高管出席，国务院副总理何立峰在会上称赞“一国两制”和“自由开放的营商环境”。社论斥之为“弥天大谎”。
美国人权组织自由之家11月5日发表题为《香港：人权组织谴责对黄之锋的不公判决》的联合声明，由多个人权组织共同签署，谴责高等法院的十年判刑，并指黄之锋被囚显示中共持续无视《中英联合声明》。自由之家9月初已与一个基金会合作，倡议释放黄之锋。
除台湾陆委会外，欧盟对外行动署发言人也就判决发表声明，促请中港当局遵守《公民权利和政治权利国际公约》及《中英联合声明》，并为政治多元保留空间。英国上议院议员奥尔顿（Lord Alton）则在社交平台表示，英国光有强烈措辞已不足够，政府必须制裁相关责任人，并要求释放黄之锋和黎智英。
港加联发表新闻稿，强烈谴责判决，指中共以层层叠加的罪名，企图令黄之锋永囚狱中，香港法庭已沦为专制政权的刑具。新闻稿指，黄之锋此前已服完多项刑期，初选案刑期亦快将完结，原预计明年1月获释，如今却再被加刑。该会称，北京惧怕黄之锋的领导能力和声音，也惧怕香港人追求民主、人权与自治的坚韧精神。该会前会长Gloria Fung说，无论刑期多长，都无法扑灭香港人对民主的渴望，北京只能不断设下法律陷阱，企图将民主运动领袖永久隔离于社会之外。港加联亦是上述自由之家联合声明的签署团体之一。
港加联促请加拿大政府：根据《马格尼茨基法案》，制裁涉及国安政治检控的官员、检控人员及法官；联同盟友在联合国人权理事会及G7施压，要求无条件释放黄之锋及所有香港政治犯；并追究中共针对加拿大港人社群的跨境镇压。港加联与其他港人团体将于11月8日（周日）在加拿大各地发起抗议。
另有海内外多个民运团体，包括香港议会、民主中国阵线、中国民主党海外委员会、社会民主党等，以《当民主成为罪名》为题联署声援。声明回顾，黄之锋在2014年雨伞运动时还是十几岁的学生，已站在社运前沿。声明强调，支持他不等于认同其每项政治决定，也不否认案件有法律争议，但人民有权表达不同意见、参与公共事务。
声明就寻求外国制裁一事表示，社会可以有不同评价，并应公开理性讨论，但爱国不应成为要求人人只持一种政治观点的理由。声明主张检视刑罚是否符合必要性和比例原则，并警告严判会造成寒蝉效应，使年轻人视参与公共事务为失去自由的风险。声明最后呼吁，不要让黄之锋的名字从香港的公共记忆中消失，并寄望香港仍有自由的未来。

香港泳滩水质等级不变，八级评为良好中国劳工公告栏
星期五, 6 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
香港泳滩水质等级不变 八级为良好
香港环境保护署每周公布海滩水质等级。 8个海滩的评级为良（1级），3个海滩的评级为一般（2级），与前一周持平。卫生部门建议大雨后三天内避免游泳
香港环境保护署（环保署）于11月6日公布最新泳滩水质等级，其中8个泳滩为良好（一级），3个泳滩为一般（二级）。所有成绩与前一周的评估相比保持不变。
环保署根据最近五个水质样本的大肠杆菌含量几何平均值，将泳滩水质分为四个等级：良好（1级）、一般（2级）、较差（3级）和极差（4级）。分级系统提供典型条件下水质的总体指示。
环保署发言人提醒市民，泳滩的等级虽然反映一般水质，但在大雨期间及过后，泳滩状况可能会受到暂时影响。建议游泳者在暴风雨或大雨后三天内避免在海滩游泳。
环保署在每个周末之前都会发布海滩等级的每周摘要。居民可透过环保署网站（www.epd.gov.hk/epd/beach_chi）或致电环保署泳滩水质热线2511 6666，查阅最新泳滩水质等级。环保署泳滩水质预测网页（www.epd.gov.hk/BWQForecast）亦提供所有向公众开放的泳滩每日水质预测。

Hong Kong beach water quality grades unchanged, eight rated good | China Labour Bulletin Board
Friday, 6 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong beach water quality grades unchanged, eight rated good
Hong Kong's Environmental Protection Department released its weekly beach water quality grading. Eight beaches are rated good (Grade 1) and three are rated general (Grade 2), unchanged from the previous week. The department advises avoiding swimming within three days after heavy rain due to potentia
The Hong Kong Environmental Protection Department (EPD) announced the latest beach water quality grades on 6 November, with eight beaches rated as good (Grade 1) and three rated as general (Grade 2). All grades remain unchanged from the previous week's assessment.
The EPD classifies beach water quality into four grades based on the geometric mean of Escherichia coli (E. coli) levels from the most recent five water samples: good (Grade 1), general (Grade 2), poor (Grade 3) and very poor (Grade 4). The grading system provides an overall indication of water quality under typical conditions.
An EPD spokesperson reminded the public that while beach grades reflect general water quality, conditions can be temporarily affected during and after periods of heavy rain. Swimmers are advised to avoid swimming at beaches within three days following a storm or heavy rainfall.
The EPD publishes a weekly summary of beach grades before each weekend. Residents can access the latest beach water quality grades based on updated data on the EPD website (www.epd.gov.hk/epd/beach_chi) or by calling the EPD beach water quality hotline at 2511 6666. Daily water quality forecasts for all beaches open to the public are also available on the EPD's beach water quality prediction webpage (www.epd.gov.hk/BWQForecast).

香港食品安全检测未发现日本进口食品辐射异常中国劳工公告栏
星期五, 6 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
香港食品安全检测未发现日本进口食品辐射异常
香港食物安全中心于2026年11月5日至6日期间检测了236个日本食品样本的辐射情况，未发现安全漏洞。自2023年8月以来，已有273,291个日本进口样品和58,162个本地渔业样品通过检测。
根据食物环境卫生署辖下食物安全中心（中心）的最新消息，香港政府食物安全监管机构报告，日本进口水产或本地水产品的辐射水平并无异常。
中心于2026年11月5日中午至11月6日中午期间，检测了236个来自日本进口的「水产品及其加工品、海藻及海盐」的食物样本。中心于11月6日发表声明称，所有样本的辐射水平均符合安全标准。
渔农自然护理署（渔护署）同期对50个本地渔产品样本进行辐射水平检测，全部合格。香港天文台亦继续加强监测本港水域的环境辐射，并无发现异常情况。
自2023年8月24日香港对日本水产品的进口限制生效以来，中心已累计检测了273,291个日本食品样本，其中包括170,098个水产品、加工品、海藻和海盐样本。渔护署已测试了58,162个本地渔产品样本。所有样品均通过辐射水平测试。
中心表示，对于不受限制进口的日本水产品、海盐及海藻，会进行全面辐射水平测试后才放行供应市场。详细结果可浏览中心关于日本进口食物管制措施的专门网页、渔护署的放射性测试网页，以及香港天文台的海水监测网页。

Hong Kong food safety tests find no abnormal radiation in Japanese imports | China Labour Bulletin Board
Friday, 6 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong food safety tests find no abnormal radiation in Japanese imports
Hong Kong's Centre for Food Safety tested 236 Japanese food samples for radiation between 5-6 November 2026, finding no safety breaches. Since August 2023, 273,291 Japanese import samples and 58,162 local fishery samples have passed tests.
The Hong Kong government's food safety watchdog has reported no abnormal radiation levels in Japanese aquatic imports or local fishery products, according to the latest updates from the Centre for Food Safety (CFS) under the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department.
Between noon on 5 November and noon on 6 November 2026, the CFS tested 236 food samples from Japanese imports of "aquatic products and their processed items, seaweed and sea salt". All samples were found to have radiation levels within safety standards, the CFS said in a statement on 6 November.
During the same period, the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department (AFCD) tested 50 local fishery product samples for radiation levels, all of which passed. The Hong Kong Observatory also continued its enhanced monitoring of environmental radiation in local waters and reported no abnormalities.
Since 24 August 2023, when Hong Kong's import restrictions on Japanese aquatic products took effect, the CFS has tested a cumulative total of 273,291 Japanese food samples, including 170,098 samples of aquatic products, processed items, seaweed and sea salt. The AFCD has tested 58,162 local fishery product samples. All samples passed radiation level tests.
The CFS noted that for Japanese aquatic products, sea salt and seaweed not subject to import bans, it conducts full radiation level testing before allowing them to be released for market supply. Detailed results are available on the CFS's dedicated webpage for control measures on Japanese food imports, the AFCD's radiological testing page, and the Hong Kong Observatory's seawater monitoring page.

香港入境处捣毁跨境假身份证、非法劳工团伙中国劳工公告栏
星期五, 6 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
香港入境处捣毁跨境假身份证、非法劳工团伙
香港入境事务处捣毁了一个跨境集团，该集团招募中国内地居民从事非法工作，提供假身份证和住宿。 15 人被捕，头目被判处最高 42 个月的监禁。
香港入境事务处捣毁了一个跨境集团，该集团招募中国内地居民进行非法就业，并向他们提供假身份证和住宿。这次行动代号为“Projection”，从2024年1月持续到2026年11月，共逮捕了15人，其中包括3名男性和12名女性，年龄在37岁至64岁之间。
调查于 2024 年 1 月开始，当时入境官员在落马洲管制站拦截了一名携带伪造香港身份证的中国内地旅客。该人曾在香港一家餐馆担任洗碗工，带领警方发现了一个网络，该网络利用社交媒体招募大陆居民，安排他们前往香港的旅行，并向他们提供假身份证和住房。
该犯罪团伙向非法劳工收取入会费、伪造文件费及宿舍租金，共骗取逾100万港元。警方在行动中检获五张伪造身份证件和44张伪造身份证件的图像或副本。被捕者包括一名雇用非法劳工的香港雇主。
两名犯罪头目较早前被定罪为串谋制作虚假文书、串谋转移伪造的香港身份证以及协助和教唆违反居住条件。他们分别被判处29个月和42个月监禁。其他犯罪团伙成员和非法劳工因违反居住条件、持有伪造身份证以及向移民官员提供虚假陈述等罪行而被判处 12 至 15 个月的徒刑。
入境处发言人警告说，根据香港法律，任何使用或管有伪造身份证的人最高可被罚款10万港元和监禁10年。未经合法授权转让身份证也可被处以最高10万港元的罚款和10年监禁。违反居留条件最高可被罚款港币 50,000 元及监禁两年。
发言人还提醒雇主，雇用非法劳工属严重罪行。根据《入境条例》，雇用无权在香港工作的人的罚款最高可达港币50万元及监禁10年。公司董事、经理、秘书和合伙人也可能面临刑事责任。上诉法院已发布量刑指南，要求对此类罪行立即入狱。
该部门提醒雇主采取一切切实可行的措施，核实工人的合法工作权利，包括检查身份证和旅行证件。它敦促人口贩运或强迫劳动的受害者举报犯罪行为，并表示将继续严格执法此类犯罪行为。

Hong Kong immigration smashes cross-border fake ID, illegal worker ring | China Labour Bulletin Board
Friday, 6 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong immigration smashes cross-border fake ID, illegal worker ring
Hong Kong's Immigration Department has broken up a cross-border syndicate that recruited mainland Chinese residents for illegal work, providing fake ID cards and accommodation. Fifteen people were arrested, and ringleaders were sentenced to up to 42 months in jail.
Hong Kong's Immigration Department has dismantled a cross-border syndicate that recruited mainland Chinese residents for illegal employment, providing them with fake identity cards and accommodation. The operation, codenamed 'Projection', ran from January 2024 to November 2026 and resulted in the arrest of 15 people, including three men and 12 women aged 37 to 64.
Investigations began in January 2024 when immigration officers at the Lok Ma Chau control point intercepted a mainland Chinese traveller carrying a forged Hong Kong identity card. The individual had been working as a dishwasher at a restaurant in Hong Kong, leading officers to uncover a network that used social media to recruit mainland residents, arrange their travel to Hong Kong, and supply them with fake ID cards and housing.
The syndicate charged illegal workers中介 fees, forgery costs and dormitory rent, amassing over HK$1 million in total. Officers seized five forged identity cards and 44 images or copies of forged cards during the operation. Those arrested included a Hong Kong employer who had hired the illegal workers.
Two ringleaders were earlier convicted of conspiracy to make false instruments, conspiracy to transfer forged Hong Kong identity cards and aiding and abetting breaches of residence conditions. They were sentenced to 29 and 42 months in prison respectively. Other syndicate members and illegal workers received sentences of 12 to 15 months for offences including breaching residence conditions, possessing forged identity cards and making false statements to immigration officers.
An Immigration Department spokesman warned that under Hong Kong law, anyone using or possessing a forged identity card faces a maximum fine of HK$100,000 and 10 years in jail. Transferring an identity card without lawful authority is also punishable by up to HK$100,000 in fines and 10 years' imprisonment. Breaching residence conditions carries a maximum penalty of HK$50,000 and two years' jail.
The spokesman also cautioned employers that hiring illegal workers is a serious offence. Under the Immigration Ordinance, penalties for employing someone not entitled to work in Hong Kong have been raised to a maximum fine of HK$500,000 and 10 years' imprisonment. Company directors, managers, secretaries and partners may also face criminal liability. The Court of Appeal has issued sentencing guidelines requiring immediate jail for such offences.
The department reminded employers to take all practicable steps to verify a worker's legal right to work, including checking identity cards and travel documents. It urged victims of human trafficking or forced labour to report offences and said it would continue strict enforcement against such crimes.

香港提议对上市前房地产投资信托基金财产转让豁免印花税中国劳工公告栏
星期五, 6 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
香港提议豁免上市前房地产投资信托基金财产转让印花税
香港财经事务及库务局副秘书长提议，对准备在香港上市的房地产投资信托基金（REIT）免除非住宅物业转让印花税。该措施在 2026-27 年度预算中宣布，旨在削减上市前成本并提振香港经济
香港财经事务及库务局副秘书长于2026年11月6日向立法会财经事务委员会通报豁免准备在香港上市的房地产投资信托基金（REITs）非住宅物业转让印花税的建议。
这位官员表示，国家“十五五”规划明确支持香港加强国际资产财富管理中心功能。据证监会调查显示，截至2025年底，香港管理的总资产达到42.2万亿港元，创历史新高，同比增长20%。流入香港资产及财富管理行业的资本净额增加近两倍，达到2.1万亿港元。今年发布的行业报告《2026年全球财富报告》将香港列为全球最大的跨境财富管理中心，并预测从2025年到2030年，香港管理的跨境财富将平均每年增长9%。
政府正在采取多项措施巩固香港的领先地位，包括推广家族办公室业务、引入多元化的基金结构、为基金业提供更优惠的税务环境以及扩大基金分销网络。具体针对 REIT 市场，政府实施了一项支持 REIT 上市的补助计划，并自 2024 年 12 月起免除 REIT 单位转让的印花税。 2026年11月11日，将提出修订《证券及期货条例》的法案，引入REIT重组或强制收购的法定机制，增强市场流动性。
2026-27 年预算中宣布的拟议印花税豁免针对的是可能需要重组资产、产生大量印花税成本的上市前房地产投资信托基金。该措施旨在降低前期上市成本，并鼓励更多房地产投资信托基金在香港设立。它适用于准备在香港上市的新房地产投资信托基金，包括那些已经在海外上市并寻求在香港进行双重主要或第二上市的房地产投资信托基金。受益人房地产投资信托基金必须在香港联合交易所（联交所）上市前六个月内完成财产转让。该豁免涵盖直接财产转让和通过特殊目的车辆股份转让，但不包括住宅财产。为了防止滥用，房地产投资信托基金必须持有财产或特殊目的工具股份至少两年，并维持其在香港联交所的上市地位至少两年。
政府建议豁免自该法案提交立法会之日起生效。一旦满足所有资格要求，过渡期间支付的印花税将予以退还。 2026年施政报告宣布正在起草相关立法建议，目标是在2027年上半年提交法案。该官员称豁免是其中一部分

Hong Kong proposes stamp duty waiver for pre-listing REIT property transfers | China Labour Bulletin Board
Friday, 6 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong proposes stamp duty waiver for pre-listing REIT property transfers
Hong Kong's Deputy Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury proposed waiving stamp duty on non-residential property transfers for real estate investment trusts (REITs) preparing to list in the city. The measure, announced in the 2026-27 budget, aims to cut pre-listing costs and boost Hong K
Hong Kong's Deputy Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury on 6 November 2026 briefed the Legislative Council's Financial Affairs Committee on a proposal to waive stamp duty on non-residential property transfers for real estate investment trusts (REITs) preparing to list in the city.
The official said the national 15th Five-Year Plan explicitly supports Hong Kong in strengthening its function as an international asset and wealth management centre. According to a Securities and Futures Commission survey, Hong Kong's total assets under management reached a record high of HK$42.2 trillion at the end of 2025, up 20 per cent year on year. Net capital inflows into the city's asset and wealth management industry nearly tripled to HK$2.1 trillion. An industry report published this year, the 2026 Global Wealth Report, ranked Hong Kong as the world's largest cross-border wealth management centre, forecasting that cross-border wealth managed from the city would grow by an average of 9 per cent annually from 2025 to 2030.
The government is pursuing multiple measures to consolidate Hong Kong's leading position, including promoting family office business, introducing diversified fund structures, providing a more favourable tax environment for the fund industry and expanding fund distribution networks. For the REIT market specifically, the government has implemented a grant scheme supporting REIT listings and, since December 2024, exempted stamp duty on transfers of REIT units. On 11 November 2026, it will table a bill amending the Securities and Futures Ordinance to introduce a statutory mechanism for REIT restructuring or compulsory acquisition, enhancing market liquidity.
The proposed stamp duty waiver, announced in the 2026-27 Budget, targets pre-listing REITs that may need to restructure assets, incurring significant stamp duty costs. The measure aims to reduce upfront listing costs and encourage more REITs to set up in Hong Kong. It applies to new REITs preparing to list in Hong Kong, including those already listed overseas seeking dual primary or secondary listing in the city. Beneficiary REITs must complete property transfers within six months before listing on the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong (SEHK). The waiver covers both direct property transfers and transfers via special purpose vehicle shares, but excludes residential property. To prevent abuse, the REIT must hold the property or special purpose vehicle shares for at least two years and maintain its SEHK listing for at least two years.
The government proposes the waiver take effect from the date the bill is tabled in the Legislative Council. Stamp duty paid during the interim period would be refundable once all eligibility requirements are met. The 2026 Policy Address announced that relevant legislative proposals are being drafted, with a target to table the bill in the first half of 2027. The official described the waiver as part of a "combination punch" supporting REIT market development, alongside efforts to include REITs in mutual market access schemes to inject growth momentum.

香港金融中心因新的税收减免、黄金清算系统而得到提振|中国劳工公告牌
2026年11月6日（星期五） ·香港香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
香港金融中心受益于新的税收减免和黄金清算系统
香港金融发展局概述了其2025-2027年工作计划，包括资产管理和金融科技的政策研究。政府宣布了针对基金和家族办公室的税收激励措施、黄金清算系统和青年实习计划，以支持该市的金融部门。香港金融服务及库务局副局长于2026年11月6日在立法会金融事务委员会发表讲话时，强调了金融发展局过去一年在政策研究、市场推广和人才培养方面的工作，以支持政府加强香港作为国际金融中心的目标。在2025-26年期间， FDB重点研究资产和财富管理、资本市场发展以及绿色和可持续金融。在2026-27年期间，研究将集中在四个主题：不断发展的贸易和投资带来的金融机会、金融技术创新、资本市场发展和财富管理。政府表示，它一直在跟进FDB的政策建议，为金融业注入新的动力。
政府宣布的具体措施包括进一步优化基金、单一家族办公室和附带权益的税收优惠。免税范围将扩大到大型单一投资者基金以及贷款、私募债投资、数字资产和贵金属等更多合格投资。该修正案预计在立法批准后从 2025-26 纳税年度起生效。为了促进房地产投资信托基金 (REIT) 的发展，本月将提出一项法案，以促进私有化或重组，并计划于 2027 年上半年推出进一步的法案，为 REITs 在上市前转让非住宅物业提供印花税豁免。
政府还正在发展香港的商品市场，首先是黄金。黄金中央清算及交收系统于2026年7月开始试运行，市场反应良好，预计于2027年第一季度全面启动。财经事务及库务局局长领导的商品交易联合工作小组于9月举行第一次会议，审查市场机会和跨交易所合作。
在市场推广方面，FDB与国内外合作伙伴签署了谅解备忘录，推出了播放量超过5,000万次的全球营销视频系列，并组织了邀请东盟和中东利益相关者来港进行市场开发合作活动。在人才发展方面，金融发展银行继续举办一年一度的人才日活动，并根据2026年施政报告宣布，将推出为期两年的青年实习计划，与业界合作提供1,000个金融服务职位。
香港财富遗产研究所是香港发展银行旗下成立的，推进了六项“遗产发展目标”的工作。它通过影响链接（iLink）项目协调家庭对公共艺术装置的捐赠，并推出了一个在线门户网站，将数十个家庭与慈善项目联系起来。学院还组织海外考察

Hong Kong financial hub gets boost from new tax breaks, gold clearing system | China Labour Bulletin Board
Friday, 6 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong financial hub gets boost from new tax breaks, gold clearing system
Hong Kong's Financial Development Bureau outlined its 2025-2027 work plan, including policy research on asset management and fintech. The government announced tax incentives for funds and family offices, a gold clearing system, and a youth internship scheme to bolster the city's financial sector.
Hong Kong's Deputy Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury, addressing the Legislative Council's Financial Affairs Committee on 6 November 2026, highlighted the Financial Development Bureau's (FDB) work over the past year in policy research, market promotion and talent cultivation to support the government's goal of strengthening the city as an international financial centre.
For the 2025-26 period, the FDB focused research on asset and wealth management, capital market development, and green and sustainable finance. In 2026-27, research will centre on four topics: financial opportunities from evolving trade and investment, financial technology innovation, capital market development, and wealth management. The government said it has been following up on the FDB's policy recommendations to inject new momentum into the financial industry.
Specific government measures announced include further optimisation of tax incentives for funds, single-family offices and carried interest. The scope of tax exemption will be expanded to cover large single-investor funds and more qualifying investments such as loans, private debt investments, digital assets and precious metals. The amendments are expected to take effect from the 2025-26 tax year after legislative approval. To boost real estate investment trust (REIT) development, a bill will be tabled this month to facilitate privatisation or restructuring, with a further bill planned for the first half of 2027 to provide stamp duty exemptions for REITs transferring non-residential properties before listing.
The government is also developing Hong Kong's commodities market, starting with gold. A gold central clearing and settlement system began trial operations in July 2026 with positive market feedback and is scheduled for full launch in the first quarter of 2027. A joint working group on commodities trading, led by the Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury, held its first meeting in September to review market opportunities and cross-exchange collaboration.
In market promotion, the FDB signed memorandums of understanding with domestic and overseas partners, launched a global marketing video series that garnered over 50 million views, and organised market development cooperation programmes inviting stakeholders from ASEAN and the Middle East to Hong Kong. For talent development, the FDB continued its annual Talent Day event and, as announced in the 2026 Policy Address, will launch a two-year youth internship programme offering 1,000 positions in financial services in partnership with the industry.
The Hong Kong Wealth Heritage Institute, established under the FDB, advanced work on six 'heritage development goals'. It coordinated family donations for public art installations through its Impact Link (iLink) project and launched an online portal connecting dozens of families with charitable projects. The institute also organised overseas exchanges for younger family members on governance, succession planning and long-term capital deployment. The government said it would continue to support the FDB and the institute as Hong Kong moves from being a 'financial city' to a 'finance-enabled city'.

zh_title: 香港特首会见上海市市长 承诺深化合作
summary: 香港特首会见上海市市长 承诺深化合作 |中国劳工公告 周五, 6 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工英文新闻 香港特首会见上海市市长，誓言深化合作 香港行政长官李家超在访问期间会见了上海市市长朱仲明，赞扬创新、数字经济和金融方面的合作。李家耀强调了香港作为离岸人民币枢纽的作用，并宣布将于 2027 年第一季度推出黄金清算系统。香港行政长官李家超在访问上海期间会见了上海市市长朱仲明。
content:
香港特首会见上海市市长 承诺深化合作 |中国劳工公告栏
星期五, 6 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
香港特首会见上海市市长 承诺深化合作
香港行政长官李家港在访问期间会见了上海市市长朱仲明，赞赏在创新、数字经济和金融方面的合作。李强调了香港作为离岸人民币枢纽的作用，并宣布将于 2027 年第一季度推出黄金清算系统。
香港行政长官李家港在上海访问期间会见了上海市市长朱仲明，国务院港澳事务办公室副主任徐其芳陪同。
李在社交媒体发帖表示，两地长期以来一直是国家对外开放的重要窗口，通过沪港合作会议等平台，在创新科技、数字经济、贸易投资、金融等领域密切合作。他表示，双方充分发挥优势互补，发挥协同效应。
李显龙表示，香港将积极发挥全球离岸人民币枢纽作用，深化与上海在离岸人民币业务方面的全面合作，共同推动人民币国际化。
他还表示，香港的黄金中央清算结算系统将于2027年第一季度开始运作。李先生表示，希望香港继续加强与上海黄金交易所、上海期货交易所等内地交易所的合作，吸引更多国际投资者，共同打造具有全球竞争力的黄金交易生态系统，为国家高质量发展作出贡献。

Hong Kong leader meets Shanghai mayor, vows deeper cooperation | China Labour Bulletin Board
Friday, 6 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong leader meets Shanghai mayor, vows deeper cooperation
Hong Kong Chief Executive John Lee met Shanghai Mayor Zhu Zhongming during a visit, praising cooperation in innovation, digital economy and finance. Lee highlighted Hong Kong's role as an offshore yuan hub and announced a gold clearing system launch in the first quarter of 2027.
Hong Kong Chief Executive John Lee met Shanghai Mayor Zhu Zhongming during a visit to the city, with Xu Qifang, deputy director of the Hong Kong and Macau Affairs Office of the State Council, also attending.
In a social media post, Lee said the two cities have long served as key windows for the country's opening-up, cooperating closely through platforms such as the Shanghai-Hong Kong Cooperation Meeting in areas including innovation and technology, the digital economy, trade and investment, and finance. He said they have fully leveraged their complementary strengths for synergistic effects.
Lee said Hong Kong will actively play its role as a global offshore renminbi hub, deepening comprehensive collaboration with Shanghai on offshore yuan business to jointly promote the internationalisation of the currency.
He also noted that Hong Kong's gold central clearing and settlement system will begin operation in the first quarter of 2027. Lee expressed hope that Hong Kong will continue to strengthen cooperation with mainland exchanges such as the Shanghai Gold Exchange and the Shanghai Futures Exchange, in order to attract more international investors and jointly build a globally competitive gold trading ecosystem, contributing to the country's high-quality development.

content:
香港贸易主管认为美国中期选举的影响有限，并指出新市场中国劳工公告栏
星期五, 6 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
香港贸易主管认为美国中期选举的影响有限，并提到新市场
香港贸易发展局主席郑慕智表示，美国中期选举结果可能会影响人工智能和半导体贸易，但香港向新兴市场多元化发展应该会限制影响。他还指出，哈萨克斯坦铁路公司计划今年在香港首次公开募股。
香港贸易发展局主席郑慕智11月6日表示，香港进出口贸易在2026年前三季度录得强劲增长。但他指出，美国中期选举后的权力更迭可能会影响人工智能产品和半导体相关贸易的表现，或会影响香港明年的贸易。
郑在上海接受香港媒体采访时表示，香港近年来探索了许多新兴市场。他对前景表示谨慎乐观，因为全球人工智能发展趋势不太可能停止。他补充说，美国人工智能的发展可能会因选举结果而放缓，而中国的发展可能会加速。
据程介绍，他收到消息称，哈萨克斯坦铁路公司已获得交易所批准上市，预计年底上市。他又指出，哈萨克斯坦主权财富基金在香港发行30亿元人民币点心债券，凸显香港作为国际金融中心的地位。
郑先生表示，香港在首次公开募股、债券市场、绿色金融和财富管理等方面表现良好。他表示，相信香港目前的国际金融中心地位将很快上升至全球第二位。

HK trade chief sees limited impact from US midterms, cites new markets | China Labour Bulletin Board
Friday, 6 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
HK trade chief sees limited impact from US midterms, cites new markets
Hong Kong Trade Development Council Chairman Moses Cheng says US midterm election results may affect AI and semiconductor trade, but Hong Kong's diversification into emerging markets should limit the impact. He also notes Kazakhstan's railway company plans a Hong Kong IPO this year.
The chairman of the Hong Kong Trade Development Council, Moses Cheng, said on 6 November that the city's import and export trade recorded strong growth in the first three quarters of 2026. However, he noted that the change in power following the US midterm elections could affect the performance of artificial-intelligence products and semiconductor-related trade, possibly impacting Hong Kong's trade next year.
Cheng, speaking to Hong Kong media while in Shanghai, said Hong Kong has explored many emerging markets in recent years. He expressed cautious optimism about the outlook, as the global trend in AI development is unlikely to stop. He added that US AI development may slow due to the election results, while China's development could accelerate.
According to Cheng, he has received information that Kazakhstan's railway company has obtained exchange approval for a listing and is expected to go public by the end of the year. He also noted that a sovereign wealth fund from Kazakhstan has issued 3 billion yuan in dim-sum bonds in Hong Kong, highlighting the city's role as an international financial centre.
Cheng said Hong Kong has performed well in initial public offerings, the bond market, green finance and wealth management. He expressed confidence that Hong Kong's current ranking as an international financial centre could soon rise to second place globally.

title: HKMA official says mainland bonds performed well, cautious distribution to continue
zh_title: 金管局官员表示内地债券表现良好 继续谨慎发行
summary: 金管局官员称内地债券表现良好，谨慎发行继续中国劳工公告周五, 2026年11月6日 · 香港 香港及中国劳工英文新闻 金管局官员称内地债券表现良好，继续谨慎发行 香港金融管理局副总裁李大智表示，中国内地国债表现良好，去年回报率约为7%，管理局将继续谨慎投资。他指出，由于立法机关的立法者过多，投资组合多元化变得越来越困难。
content:
金管局官员称内地债券表现良好，谨慎发行继续中国劳工公告栏
星期五, 6 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
金管局官员表示内地债券表现良好 继续谨慎发行
香港金管局副总裁李大志表示，内地国债表现良好，去年回报率约为7%，金管局将继续谨慎投资。他指出，由于严重的合作，投资组合多元化的难度越来越大。
立法会财经事务委员会有议员询问，鉴于近期欧美国债收益率大幅上升，而中国内地国债收益率保持稳定，外汇基金会否调整债券资产配置。
香港金融管理局（金管局）副总裁李大志表示，金管局近年来对内地国债的投资表现良好。尽管收益率下降，但债券价值上升，当局还录得汇兑收益。去年中国大陆国债投资的回报率达到了7%左右，他认为这个回报率相当不错。他表示，金管局未来将继续谨慎分配投资。
李以外汇基金早期投资人民币为例，称该基金是被中国市场与其他海外市场的相关性较低所吸引。他强调了确保不同资产能够在不同经济周期提供一定程度保护的重要性。
李说，市场目前预计美联储今年将再次加息，但市场情绪可能会很快转变。当局将继续根据当地经济状况、通胀和数据变化调整货币政策。他强调，金管局作为大型机构投资者，不能简单地“赌博”或频繁进出市场。它必须确保适当的风险分配和投资多元化。
然而，李承认，实现投资组合多元化正变得越来越困难。目前全球股权投资配置主要集中在美股，甚至集中在市值最大的股票上。他表示，当局需要进一步考虑其投资组合是否足够多元化。

HKMA official says mainland bonds performed well, cautious distribution to continue | China Labour Bulletin Board
Friday, 6 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
HKMA official says mainland bonds performed well, cautious distribution to continue
Hong Kong Monetary Authority Deputy Chief Executive Li Dazhi said mainland Chinese government bonds have performed well, with a return rate of about 7 per cent last year, and the authority will continue to invest cautiously. He noted increasing difficulty in portfolio diversification due to heavy co
A legislator at the Legislative Council's Panel on Financial Affairs asked whether the Exchange Fund would adjust its bond asset allocation, given that yields on European and US government bonds have risen sharply recently while mainland Chinese government bond yields have remained stable.
Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) Deputy Chief Executive Li Dazhi said the authority's investments in mainland Chinese government bonds in recent years have performed well. Although yields have declined, bond values have risen and the authority has also recorded exchange gains. The return rate on mainland Chinese government bond investments last year reached about 7 per cent, which he described as quite good. The HKMA will continue to distribute its investments cautiously in the future, he said.
Li cited the Exchange Fund's early investments in the renminbi as an example, saying the fund was attracted by the lower correlation between the Chinese market and other overseas markets. He stressed the importance of ensuring that different assets can provide a certain level of protection across different economic cycles.
The market currently expects the US Federal Reserve to raise interest rates once more this year, Li said, but market sentiment can shift very quickly. The authority will continue to adjust monetary policy based on local economic conditions, inflation and data changes. He emphasised that as a large institutional investor, the HKMA cannot simply "gamble" or enter and exit markets frequently. It must ensure proper risk distribution and diversification of investments.
However, Li acknowledged that achieving portfolio diversification is becoming increasingly difficult. Global equity investment allocation is now heavily concentrated in US stocks, even focusing on the largest stocks by market capitalisation. He said the authority needs to further consider whether its investment portfolio is sufficiently diversified.

title: China sees fastest emissions drop since Covid amid Middle East war disruption
zh_title: 由于中东战争的破坏，中国的排放量出现自新冠疫情以来最快的下降
summary: 中东战事混乱，中国出现自新冠疫情以来最快的排放量下降中国劳工布告栏，周五，2026 年 11 月 6 日·香港 香港和中国劳工英文新闻 根据 Carbon Brief 援引 CREA 的分析，在中东战争的干扰下，中国的二氧化碳排放量在 2026 年第三季度下降了 3.1%，这是自疫情以来最快的季度降幅。这一下降与中东战争导致通过霍尔木兹海峡的石油运输中断有关，全年石油使用量下降 4%，运输石油消耗量下降 9%——中国二氧化碳排放量下降
content:
中东战事混乱，中国出现自新冠疫情以来最快的排放量下降中国劳工公告栏
星期五, 6 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
由于中东战争的破坏，中国的排放量出现自新冠疫情以来最快的下降
Carbon Brief 援引 CREA 的分析称，2026 年第三季度中国二氧化碳排放量下降了 3.1%，这是自疫情爆发以来最快的季度降幅。这一下降与中东战争导致通过霍尔木兹海峡的石油运输中断有关，去年石油使用量下降了 4%，运输石油消耗量下降了 9%。
一家智库周五表示，今年第三季度中国的二氧化碳排放量下降了自Covid-19大流行以来最快的速度，并将下降归因于中东战争的影响。
根据《Carbon Brief》发布的能源与清洁空气研究中心 (CREA) 的分析，亚洲庞大经济体的排放量在 7 月至 9 月期间下降了 3.1%。重要的霍尔木兹海峡交通严重中断，严重影响了对中国这个世界第二大经济体和最大原油进口国的石油运输。
CREA报告援引官方数据和商业数据称，总体石油使用量同比下降4%，而运输石油消耗量下降9%。 CREA联合创始人兼首席分析师劳里·米利维尔塔(Lauri Myllyvirta)告诉法新社，“很明显，一旦油价下跌，石油消费就会出现某种程度的反弹。” '这与中国的石油消费很可能在冲击之前达到顶峰的背景相反。这次冲击显然加速了电气化趋势和远离石油的趋势。
尽管中国快速建设新燃煤电厂，但煤炭使用量也同比下降了 3%。绿色和平东亚分部北京项目负责人高玉和表示，煤电持续下降趋势是可再生能源进一步发展的关键因素。他补充说，与此同时，我们需要看到可再生能源的扩大应用以及可再生能源和储能系统的市场化。
该国可再生能源装机出现爆炸性增长，但近年来煤炭在能源结构中的份额逐渐下降。中国是世界上最大的排放国，排放的温室气体占全球的30%以上。其领导人承诺加大力度减少二氧化碳排放并推动绿色转型，目标是到 2060 年实现碳中和。

China sees fastest emissions drop since Covid amid Middle East war disruption | China Labour Bulletin Board
Friday, 6 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
China sees fastest emissions drop since Covid amid Middle East war disruption
China's CO2 emissions fell 3.1% in Q3 2026, the fastest quarterly drop since the pandemic, according to CREA analysis cited by Carbon Brief. The decline is linked to Middle East war disruption of oil shipments via the Strait of Hormuz, with oil use down 4% and transport oil consumption down 9% year-
China's carbon dioxide emissions fell in the third quarter of this year at the fastest rate since the Covid-19 pandemic, a think tank said on Friday, attributing the drop to impacts from the Middle East war.
The massive Asian economy's emissions fell by 3.1 per cent between July and September, according to analysis by the Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air (CREA) published by Carbon Brief. Severe disruption to traffic through the crucial Strait of Hormuz has heavily impacted oil shipments to China, the world's second-largest economy and the top importer of crude.
Overall oil use fell by four per cent year-on-year while transport oil consumption decreased by nine per cent, the CREA report said, citing official figures and commercial data. 'It's clear there is going to be some kind of a rebound in oil consumption once, or if, prices come down,' CREA co-founder and lead analyst Lauri Myllyvirta told AFP. 'That's against the context that China's oil consumption had highly likely peaked before the shock. The shock has clearly accelerated the electrification trend and the shift away from oil.'
Coal use also fell by three per cent year-on-year despite China's rapid construction of new coal plants. 'Coal power sustaining a downward trend is a key factor in the further development of renewable energy,' said Gao Yuhe, the Beijing-based project lead at Greenpeace East Asia. 'At the same time, we need to see expanding uptake of renewable energy and marketisation of renewable energy and energy storage systems,' he added.
The country has seen explosive growth in renewable installation, with coal's share in its energy mix edging down in recent years. China is the world's biggest emitter, responsible for over 30 per cent of global greenhouse gases. Its leaders have promised to step up efforts to reduce CO2 and boost the green transition, aiming for carbon neutrality by 2060.

香港成为全球第二大生物科技筹款中心：FS |中国劳工公告栏
星期五, 6 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
香港成为全球第二大生物科技筹款中心：FS
财政司司长陈茂波表示，自 2018 年改革允许尚未盈利的生物科技公司上市以来，香港已成为全球第二大生物科技融资中心。他概述了建立药品和医疗器械监管机构、促进跨境数据流动以及建立生命科学机构的计划。
财政司司长陈茂波11月6日表示，自2018年改革允许尚未盈利的生物科技公司上市以来，香港已成为全球第二大生物科技融资中心。他在国际生物计算创新峰会上发表讲话。
陈肇始表示，国家“十五五”规划将生物医药确定为新兴支柱产业，并将生物制造、脑机接口确定为未来发展方向。香港正在优先支持这些行业。
陈表示，通过公私合作伙伴关系和耐心资本，目的不仅是增加研究支出，而且是为有前景的研究提供时间来证明其有效性，并将资源引导到有效领域。 2025年12月，一家人工智能药物发现公司在香港上市，投资者包括国际制药公司和一家中国科技集团，展示了香港连接内地与海外制药公司、科技公司和投资者的“超级联系人”作用。
陈表示，香港将为研究人员提供临床试验基础设施、专业人才和监管框架，以帮助验证疗法的安全性和有效性。主要举措包括建立香港药品和医疗器械监管中心，建立独立评估能力，促进深港创新科技区的跨境数据和生物样本流动，连接实验室、临床试验和现实世界研究，以及设立生命与健康科学研究所。
他表示，研究院将与香港科技大学共同推进第三所医学院的建设，从一开始就以临床研究为主。香港还可以为国际制药公司和投资者提供一个熟悉且值得信赖的平台，以获取中国正在开发的新药，将创新与市场联系起来。

Friday, 6 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong becomes world's second-largest biotech fundraising hub: FS
Financial Secretary Paul Chan said Hong Kong has become the world's second-largest biotech fundraising hub since a 2018 reform allowed pre-revenue biotech firms to list. He outlined plans to build a drug and medical device regulator, boost cross-border data flows, and establish a life sciences insti
Financial Secretary Paul Chan said on 6 November that Hong Kong has become the world's second-largest biotechnology fundraising centre since a 2018 reform allowed pre-revenue biotech companies to list. He was speaking at the International Biocomputing Innovation Summit.
Chan noted that the nation's 15th Five-Year Plan designates biomedicine as an emerging pillar industry and identifies biomanufacturing and brain-computer interfaces as future development directions. Hong Kong is prioritising support for these sectors.
Through public-private partnerships and patient capital, Chan said the aim is not just to increase research spending but to give promising research time to prove its effectiveness and direct resources to effective areas. In December 2025, an AI drug discovery company listed in Hong Kong with investors including international pharmaceutical firms and a Chinese technology group, demonstrating the city's "super-connector" role linking mainland and overseas drug firms, tech companies and investors.
Chan said Hong Kong will provide researchers with clinical trial infrastructure, professional talent and a regulatory framework to help validate the safety and efficacy of therapies. Key initiatives include establishing a Hong Kong drug and medical device regulatory centre to build independent assessment capacity, promoting cross-border data and biosample flows in the Shenzhen-Hong Kong Innovation and Technology Zone to connect laboratories, clinical trials and real-world studies, and setting up a life and health sciences institute.
He added that the institute will work with Hong Kong University of Science and Technology to advance the construction of a third medical school, focusing on clinical research from the start. Hong Kong can also offer international pharmaceutical firms and investors a familiar and trusted platform to access new drugs being developed in China, connecting innovation with the market.

content:
香港男子在生日报复视频中揭露出轨女友 |中国劳工公告栏
星期五, 6 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
香港男子生日报复视频揭露出轨女友
一名香港男子在他们三周年纪念日期间录制了自己曝光女友与老板的恋情的视频后，在 Threads 上疯传。他在海边蒙住了她的眼睛，然后展示了她出轨对话的截图。这条帖子半天就获得了超过5万个赞。
一名香港男子在社交媒体平台 Threads 上发布了一段视频，视频中他揭露了女友在本应是他们三周年纪念日和生日庆祝活动期间的不忠行为，该视频迅速走红。
根据原始发帖者的说法，涉案第三方据信是该女子的老板，尽管知道她处于忠诚的关系中，但仍对她进行追求。该男子回忆在铜锣湾给她买了一份生日礼物，后来才知道她当时正在与老板交换信息，表达她有多么想念他并想见他。
当晚，该男子感觉情况不对，趁她熟睡时检查了她的手机。他不仅发现了过于亲热的聊天记录，还发现了老板提供的私人聚会和乘车回家的证据。
他没有立即与她对质，而是制定了详细的复仇计划。他以浪漫的姿态带她来到海边，从后面遮住了她的眼睛。当他松开手并在手机上显示聊天记录时，该女子最初一笑置之，并询问她何时出轨。男人很快打断了她的话，直接质问了她消息中的人的身份。
然后他列出了他所学到的一切——包括她在另一个男人给她买礼物时给他发消息、接受搭车，以及在他们一起庆祝她生日的那天告诉她的老板她想念他。整个事件被视频记录下来。
该帖子和相关视频在社交媒体平台上迅速传播，半天内获得了超过 50,000 个点赞。网友们普遍对这名男子表示同情，同时称赞他出色的情绪控制能力。许多人评论说，为了在镜头前揭露真相，他需要一整天抑制住愤怒，需要极大的镇静。其他人注意到视频中的鲜明对比，称语气看似平静，但情绪沉重。一些评论者指出，这种情况令人深感悲伤，而不是有趣，质疑这名女子如何在面对时微笑着并且不表示悔恨或解释。

Friday, 6 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong man exposes cheating girlfriend in birthday revenge video
A Hong Kong man went viral on Threads after recording himself exposing his girlfriend's alleged affair with her boss during their third anniversary. He blindfolded her at the seaside, then showed screenshots of her cheating conversations. The post received over 50,000 likes in half a day.
A Hong Kong man has gone viral after posting a video on the social media platform Threads showing how he exposed his girlfriend's alleged infidelity during what was supposed to be their third anniversary and her birthday celebration.
According to the original poster, the third party involved is believed to be the woman's boss, who allegedly pursued her despite knowing she was in a committed relationship. The man recalled buying her a birthday present in Causeway Bay, only to learn later that she was exchanging messages with her boss at that exact moment, expressing how much she missed him and wanted to see him.
Feeling that something was off, the man checked her phone while she was asleep later that night. He uncovered not only overly affectionate chat logs but also proof of private meetups and rides home provided by the boss.
Instead of confronting her immediately, he devised a detailed revenge plan. He took her to the seafront under the pretense of a romantic gesture, covering her eyes from behind. When he removed his hands and displayed the chat logs on his phone, the woman initially laughed it off, asking when she had ever cheated. The man quickly cut her off, confronting her directly about the identity of the person in the messages.
He then laid out everything he had learned—including her messaging the other man while he was shopping for her gift, accepting rides, and telling her boss she missed him on the very day they celebrated her birthday together. The entire incident was recorded on video.
The post and accompanying footage spread rapidly across social media platforms, amassing over 50,000 likes within half a day. Netizens widely expressed sympathy for the man while praising his remarkable emotional control. Many commented on the immense composure required to hold back his anger for a full day just to execute the reveal on camera. Others noted the poignant contrast in the video, describing the tone as deceptively calm yet emotionally heavy. Several commenters noted that the situation was deeply sad rather than entertaining, questioning how the woman could smile and offer no remorse or explanation upon being confronted.

局长表示，大湾区是中国最开放、经济最活跃的地区之一，香港一直致力于利用普通法优势打造“软互联互通”路径。他指出，国家“十五五”规划要求深化粤港澳大湾区建设，加强法治保障，而香港9月发布的第一个五年规划旨在加强香港作为国际法律和争议解决中心的作用。
秘书强调了 2026 年的两个重要里程碑：8 月，中国全国人民代表大会常务委员会修订了《律师法》，使大湾区律师计划永久生效，并于 9 月生效； 10月，司法部发布实施细则，规范考试报名、许可程序和执业范围。他感谢司法部和广东省司法厅自2020年8月试点启动以来的支持。
司法部、澳门政府、广东省司法厅的领导，以及大湾区律师协会、香港律师会、香港大律师公会的代表在论坛上致辞。圆桌讨论涵盖跨境争议解决、法律科技、绿色金融、数据合规、跨境投资审查等领域。
下午，粤港澳调解员运用《大湾区跨境纠纷调解示范规则》进行模拟调解，展示规则统一，推动调解作为纠纷解决工具。局长鼓励香港法律专业人士参加大湾区考试，抓住该地区的机遇，并指出这是香港第一个五年计划的目标。

Hong Kong legal chief hails milestone for Greater Bay Area lawyer scheme
Hong Kong's Secretary for Justice opened the second Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macau Greater Bay Area Lawyers Forum, highlighting that over 700 lawyers have qualified under the scheme. The forum, themed 'Legal Wisdom Bay Area', explored dispute resolution, legal tech and cross-border services as the system
6 Nov 2026 at 13:43 HKT · updated 6 Nov, 15:59 · 2 min read
Hong Kong's Secretary for Justice opened the second Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macau Greater Bay Area Lawyers Forum on 6 November, saying more than 700 legal practitioners from Hong Kong and Macau have now obtained dual-qualification status under the Greater Bay Area lawyer scheme. The forum, themed 'Legal Wisdom Bay Area', attracted over 900 online and in-person participants.
The Secretary said the Greater Bay Area is one of China's most open and economically vibrant regions, and that Hong Kong has been working to create 'soft connectivity' paths leveraging its common-law advantages. He noted that the national 15th Five-Year Plan called for deepening the bay area's construction and strengthening legal safeguards, while Hong Kong's first five-year plan, released in September, aims to bolster the city's role as an international legal and dispute resolution hub.
The Secretary highlighted two key milestones in 2026: in August, China's National People's Congress Standing Committee amended the Lawyers Law to make the Greater Bay Area lawyer scheme permanent, effective September; and in October, the Ministry of Justice issued implementing rules standardising exam registration, licensing procedures and practice scope. He thanked the Ministry of Justice and Guangdong Provincial Justice Department for their support since the pilot scheme began in August 2020.
The forum featured addresses by leaders from the Ministry of Justice, the Macau government and Guangdong's justice department, as well as representatives from the Greater Bay Area Lawyers Association, the Law Society of Hong Kong and the Hong Kong Bar Association. Panel discussions covered cross-border dispute resolution, legal technology, green finance, data compliance and cross-border investment review.
In the afternoon, mediators from Guangdong, Hong Kong and Macau conducted a simulated mediation using the Greater Bay Area Cross-Border Dispute Mediation Model Rules, demonstrating rule harmonisation and promoting mediation as a dispute resolution tool. The Secretary encouraged Hong Kong legal professionals to take the bay area exam and seize opportunities in the region, noting this is a target in Hong Kong's first five-year plan.

中国8月1日特技飞行表演队飞越长城庆祝空军建军周年|中国劳工公告栏
星期五, 6 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
中国8月1日特技飞行表演队飞越长城庆祝空军建军周年
周五上午，中国人民解放军空军8月1日飞行表演队的6架歼10战斗机飞越天津雅仑关长城上空，纪念空军成立77周年。该团队此前曾于 2024 年飞越埃及金字塔。
据香港电台报道，周五上午，中国人民解放军空军8月1日特技飞行队在天津雅仑关长城上空飞行了六架歼10展示机，纪念中国人民解放军空军成立77周年。
飞机以紧密队形进行低空山谷飞行，六架喷气式飞机保持最小间距。飞机在飞越时释放出红色、黄色和蓝色的烟雾尾迹。
领队李斌表示，此次长城飞越是继2024年该队飞越埃及金字塔之后的一次飞行。 “金字塔见证了人类古老文明，长城是中华民族的精神图腾。”李说。他补充说，飞越这些世界地标，展示了战略空军开放、自信的形象。
“随着空军现代化建设的不断推进，飞行队的航迹将延伸到更远的地方。”李说。
8月1日飞行表演队以中国人民解放军成立日期命名，是空军的公开展示单位。它之前的国际亮相包括 2024 年飞越埃及吉萨金字塔。
长城天桥在雅仑关段举行，雅仑关是天津市一座经过修复的明代防御工事，距北京东南约 120 公里。

Friday, 6 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
China's August 1st aerobatic team flies over Great Wall for air force anniversary
Six J-10 fighter jets from the People's Liberation Army Air Force's August 1st aerobatic team flew over the Yalunguan section of the Great Wall in Tianjin on Friday morning, marking the 77th anniversary of the air force's founding. The team previously flew over Egypt's pyramids in 2024.
The People's Liberation Army Air Force's August 1st aerobatic team flew six J-10 display aircraft over the Yalunguan section of the Great Wall in Tianjin on Friday morning, marking the 77th anniversary of the air force's founding, state broadcaster Radio Television Hong Kong reported.
The aircraft performed a low-altitude valley flight in a tight formation, with the six jets maintaining minimal spacing. The planes released red, yellow and blue smoke trails during the flyover.
Team leader Li Bin said the Great Wall flyover followed the team's 2024 flight over Egypt's pyramids. "The pyramids bear witness to humanity's ancient civilisation, while the Great Wall is the spiritual totem of the Chinese nation," Li said. He added that flying over these world landmarks showcased the strategic air force's open and confident image.
"As the air force's modernisation continues to advance, the team's flight path will extend to even further places," Li said.
The August 1st aerobatic team, named after the founding date of the PLA, serves as the air force's public display unit. Its previous international appearance included the 2024 flyover of the Giza pyramids in Egypt.
The Great Wall flyover took place at the Yalunguan section, a restored Ming dynasty fortification in Tianjin municipality, about 120 kilometres southeast of Beijing.

content:
香港交易所报告第三季度利润下降1% |中国劳工公告栏
星期五, 6 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
港交所报告第三季度利润下降1%
香港交易及结算所（香港交易所）第三季度净利润下降1%至48.6亿港元，但前9个月累计利润增长15%至154.3亿港元。首席执行官 Edith Chan 将增长归因于强劲的市场活动
香港交易及结算所（港交所）11月6日公布的业绩显示，第三季度净利润为48.6亿港元，同比下降约1%，环比下降10%。
该季度营收及其他收入总计78.7亿港元，同比增长1%，但环比下降7%。核心业务收入为74.7亿港元，同比下降0.2%，环比第二季度下降约4%，主要是由于第二季度创纪录的营业额回落导致交易和结算费用下降，以及托管费减少。
今年前9个月，港交所净利润同比增长15%至154.3亿港元。收入及其他收入增长12%至245.7亿港元，其中核心业务收入增长12%。
行政总裁陈伊迪表示，交易所前三季度业务发展稳健，市场成交活跃，期内收入和利润均创历史新高。现货、衍生品、大宗商品市场交投活跃，体现了多元化资产生态建设初见成效。
陈茂波强调了第三季度的主要进展，包括审查上市机制竞争力、推出首个离岸市场上市的中国国债期货、简化香港证券市场的交易手数，以及推出首个追踪香港交易所新跨市场指数的交易所交易基金。
她表示，在宏观经济不确定性加剧、市场持续波动的情况下，香港交易所比以往任何时候都更加坚定地构建更深层次、更多元化的资产生态系统。

Hong Kong Exchange reports 1 per cent fall in third-quarter profit | China Labour Bulletin Board
Friday, 6 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong Exchange reports 1 per cent fall in third-quarter profit
Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing (HKEX) posted a 1 per cent drop in third-quarter net profit to 4.86 billion Hong Kong dollars, though cumulative profit for the first nine months rose 15 per cent to 15.43 billion Hong Kong dollars. Chief Executive Edith Chan attributed growth to robust market activi
Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing (HKEX) reported a net profit of 4.86 billion Hong Kong dollars for the third quarter, down approximately 1 per cent year on year and 10 per cent from the previous quarter, according to results published on 6 November.
Revenue and other income for the quarter totalled 7.87 billion Hong Kong dollars, up 1 per cent from a year earlier but down 7 per cent quarter on quarter. Core business revenue stood at 7.47 billion Hong Kong dollars, a decline of 0.2 per cent year on year and about 4 per cent from the second quarter, mainly due to lower trading and settlement fees amid a retreat from the second quarter's record-high turnover, as well as reduced custody fees.
For the first nine months of the year, HKEX's net profit increased by 15 per cent year on year to 15.43 billion Hong Kong dollars. Revenue and other income grew 12 per cent to 24.57 billion Hong Kong dollars, with core business revenue rising 12 per cent.
Chief Executive Edith Chan said the exchange had achieved steady business development and vibrant market turnover in the first three quarters, with record-high revenue and profit for the period. Active trading in the cash, derivatives and commodity markets reflected the initial success of building a diversified asset ecosystem.
Chan highlighted key progress in the third quarter, including a review of listing mechanism competitiveness, the launch of the first offshore market-listed Chinese government bond futures, simplification of trading board lots for Hong Kong's securities market, and the introduction of the first exchange-traded funds tracking the exchange's new cross-market indices.
She said that amid heightened macroeconomic uncertainty and persistent market volatility, HKEX was more determined than ever to build a deeper and more diversified asset ecosystem.

content:
加拿大预计到2027年清除香港“救生艇”公关积压|中国劳工公告栏
星期五, 6 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
加拿大预计到2027年清理香港“救生艇”公关积压
加拿大的 2027-2029 年移民水平计划包括一项临时措施，授予多达 200,000 个额外的永久居留名额。人道主义工作流针对香港剩余的“救生艇”计划申请，预计到 2027 年清除积压的申请。
继加拿大移民、难民和公民部（IRCC）周四宣布移民政策更新后，加拿大预计到 2027 年根据“救生艇”计划清理积压的香港居民永久居留申请。
此次更新是加拿大新公布的 2027-2029 年移民水平计划的一部分，该计划为期三年，维持每年约 38​​ 万新永久居民的目标，同时将每年新增临时居民人数上限限制在 37 万。
更新战略的一个关键组成部分是一项有时限的一年措施，在标准移民上限之外提供最多 200,000 个额外的永久居留名额。该措施针对的是已经居住在加拿大并为当地社区做出贡献的个人。
招生人数将平均分为两个部分：工人队列最多 100,000 个名额，人道主义队列最多 100,000 个名额。人道主义类别包括香港救生艇计划和乌克兰家庭团聚途径的申请人。
人道主义拨款将覆盖通过指定途径申请的居住在加拿大的个人，特别是为了完成香港永久居留途径下的所有剩余申请，该途径已于 8 月 31 日正式停止接受新申请人。因此，在截止日期之前提交文件并仍在队列中的香港申请人预计他们的文件将在 2027 年得到处理。
IRCC强调，临时安排并不构成新的移民途径，也不会导致未来年度移民目标的永久增加。

Canada expects to clear Hong Kong 'lifeboat' PR backlog by 2027
Canada's 2027–2029 Immigration Levels Plan includes a temporary measure to grant up to 200,000 extra permanent residence slots. The humanitarian stream targets remaining Hong Kong 'lifeboat' scheme applications, with backlog expected cleared by 2027.
Canada expects to clear a backlog of permanent residency applications from Hong Kong residents under its 'lifeboat' scheme by 2027, following an immigration policy update announced on Thursday by Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC).
The update came as part of Canada's newly unveiled 2027–2029 Immigration Levels Plan, a three-year roadmap that maintains an annual target of roughly 380,000 new permanent residents while capping new temporary resident arrivals at 370,000 per year.
A key component of the updated strategy is a time-limited, one-year measure providing up to 200,000 additional permanent residence slots outside standard immigration caps. The measure targets individuals already residing in Canada who have contributed to local communities.
The intake will be split evenly across two streams: up to 100,000 spots for a worker cohort and up to 100,000 spots for a humanitarian cohort. The humanitarian stream includes applicants under the Hong Kong Lifeboat Scheme as well as the Ukraine Family Reunification Pathway.
The humanitarian allocation will cover individuals residing in Canada who applied through designated pathways, specifically aiming to finalise all remaining applications under the Hong Kong permanent residence pathway, which officially closed to new applicants on 31 August. As a result, Hong Kong applicants who submitted their paperwork before the cutoff date and remain in the queue can expect their files to be processed within 2027.
IRCC emphasised that the temporary arrangement does not constitute a new immigration pathway, nor will it result in a permanent increase to annual immigration targets moving forward.

title: 中國醫保參保人數連七年下降 減少8300萬人
summary: 圖為醫院示意圖。(Noel Celis/AFP via Getty Images) 【大紀元2026年11月06日訊】（大紀元記者方曉綜合報導）中國居民醫保參保人數連續七年下降，2019年至2025年累計減少約8300萬人。有研究指出，居民醫保採取定額繳費制度，個人繳費標準多年持續上調，對低收入群體造成較大的相對負擔。農村低收入家庭、人口較多的家庭，以及主要依靠較低養老金生活的老人，面臨更突出的繳費可負擔性問題。 中共國家醫保局11月5日舉行醫保錢包2.0版媒體解讀會，針對網
content:
圖為醫院示意圖。(Noel Celis/AFP via Getty Images)
【大紀元2026年11月06日訊】（大紀元記者方曉綜合報導）中國居民醫保參保人數連續七年下降，2019年至2025年累計減少約8300萬人。有研究指出，居民醫保採取定額繳費制度，個人繳費標準多年持續上調，對低收入群體造成較大的相對負擔。農村低收入家庭、人口較多的家庭，以及主要依靠較低養老金生活的老人，面臨更突出的繳費可負擔性問題。
中共國家醫保局11月5日舉行醫保錢包2.0版媒體解讀會，針對網絡上討論的「居民醫保參保人數七連降、減少8300萬」解釋稱，參保人數下降主要涉及三方面原因。
一是治理重複參保，2019至2024年全國從居民醫保口徑剔除重複參保等無效數據約2500萬人；二是居民醫保轉向職工醫保，2019至2025年職工醫保人數從3.29億增至3.89億，淨增約6000萬，很大部分由居民醫保轉入；三是常住人口減少，中國人口於2021年達到峰值，2022年至2025年已連續四年下降。
不過，上述三項因素目前並沒有完整的數字拆分。官方公布了清理的重複參保人數、職工醫保增加人數及人口減少數量，但沒有逐項說明這些因素分別對居民醫保減少的8300萬人造成多大影響，也沒有公布因繳費負擔而中斷參保的人數。
參保人數下降，而居民醫保個人繳費標準多年持續上調。崑山杜克大學全球健康研究中心衛生政策研究協作組近日發布的《城鄉居民基本醫療保險參保人數下降問題及對策研究》稱，2019年至2025年，居民醫保個人年度繳費標準由250元（人民幣，下同）提高至400元，增幅達60%；同期財政補助標準由520元提高至700元，增幅約35%。個人繳費增幅高於財政補助。
崑山杜克大學位於江蘇省崑山市，是由美國杜克大學與中國武漢大學合作創辦的中外合作大學。
該研究以農村居民收入數據分析指出，居民醫保採取定額繳費方式，不同收入群體繳納相同標準，對低收入者形成更大的相對負擔。2003年至2024年，農村最低收入20%群體的醫保個人繳費占人均可支配收入比例，由約1.2%升至7.4%；最高收入20%群體的這一比例則一直低於1%。
該研究統計，2019—2025年，居民醫保參保人數連續7年下降，累計減少約8300萬人。
研究還指出，按人頭繳費會放大家庭人口多所承受的負擔。例如，河北一個有4至8名成員的家庭，每年居民醫保繳費可達1600至3200元，對部分低收入家庭而言，可能接近一個月的收入。
此外，醫療救助對困難群體的參保支持也存在地區差異。研究認為，各地救助資助標準及對象認定不同，可能削弱部分經濟脆弱群體持續參保的能力。
中國就業情況不佳，靈活就業者越來越多，但靈活就業者難以轉入職工醫保。
據《香港經濟日報》10月22日報導，中共人社部直屬研究機構中國勞動和社會保障科學研究院醫保室副研究員趙瑩今年9月估算，以約2億名靈活就業者計算，參加職工醫保的比例約為34.9%，即超過六成未參加職工醫保。上述統計未計入參加城鄉居民醫保的人員，不能據此認定其餘人員全部沒有醫療保障。
靈活就業者包括外賣員、網約車司機、家政服務人員及自由職業者等。報導將他們參保困難歸納為繳交保費壓力大、收入不穩定，以及對長期繳費回報存疑。
與有固定工作單位的職工不同，靈活就業者需要自行承擔相關社保費用。報導以上海為例，靈活就業者按最低標準繳納養老及醫療保險，每月合計超過2200元。收入一旦下降，便可能難以持續負擔。
此外，隨著延遲退休逐步實施，按月領取職工基本養老金的最低繳費年限，將從2030年起由15年逐步提高至20年。部分年輕人因此擔心繳費時間拉長，未來待遇又存在不確定性，寧願把現金留在手中應付眼前生活。
對居民而言，每年要繳多少保費、家庭是否負擔得起、看病時能報銷多少，這些都是決定是否繼續參保的現實考量。
根據中共國家醫保局公布的《2025年全國醫療保障事業發展統計公報》，2025年居民醫保參保人員住院費用中，醫保基金對目錄內費用的支付比例為66%；按醫院級別計算，三級醫院為61.7%，二級醫院為71.8%，一級及以下醫院為79.4%。
需要注意的是，這是醫保目錄內住院費用的基金支付比例，並不代表患者全部醫療費用都能按這個比例報銷。目錄外藥品、檢查及其它個人負擔項目，仍可能增加患者實際支出。

title: 北京升級整肅「老好人」 專家揭背後權術
summary: 2026年3月11日，中共政協會議閉幕式結束後，代表們離開北京人民大會堂。 (Lintao Zhang/POOL/AFP via Getty Images) 【大紀元2026年11月06日訊】（大紀元記者唐兵、駱亞採訪報導）日前公布的中共二十屆五中全會「決定」，除要求揪出「兩面人」外，也敲打所謂「老好人」，被指釋放清洗信號。專家認為，這是中共黨魁習近平為了在中共二十一大前控制局面，找理由整肅不聽話官員的權術。 據中共官媒發布的五中全會所謂「全面從嚴治黨若干重大問題」決定文件，
content:
2026年3月11日，中共政協會議閉幕式結束後，代表們離開北京人民大會堂。 (Lintao Zhang/POOL/AFP via Getty Images)
【大紀元2026年11月06日訊】（大紀元記者唐兵、駱亞採訪報導）日前公布的中共二十屆五中全會「決定」，除要求揪出「兩面人」外，也敲打所謂「老好人」，被指釋放清洗信號。專家認為，這是中共黨魁習近平為了在中共二十一大前控制局面，找理由整肅不聽話官員的權術。
據中共官媒發布的五中全會所謂「全面從嚴治黨若干重大問題」決定文件，當中提到，要反對當「老好人」。
今年2月，中共黨刊《求是》曾發表文章稱，「老好人」在每年的幹部考核期間尤其活躍，通常會在不同利益之間尋求平衡，試圖討好所有人，卻對基本規矩和原則視而不見。
港媒《南華早報》報導，中共長期以來一直批評那些扮演「好好先生」的幹部。而中共五中全會通過的上述決定，明確地將這類「老好人」行為列為整頓對象，是相當罕見的升高整頓動作。
報導提到，前中共湖南省衡陽市委書記童名謙就是因「老好人」作風而被整肅的知名案例。2013年間，衡陽市人大代表選舉中，527名代表中有518人涉及收受賄款，童名謙未下令調查制止而被查落馬，並於2014年8月被判刑5年。全案的賄款金額高達人民幣1.1億元。
對於中共要整頓「老好人」，悉尼科技大學副教授馮崇義對大紀元表示，這本身是權謀術，習近平要下邊互相鬥，互相告狀，都告到他那裡去，由他來裁決，增加他的權威。
他表示，習近平要你不能當老好人，要敢於鬥爭。有人想藉這個機會去巴結習近平，去舉報別人，然後就升官了。「不讓當老好人，實際上就是要你當小人，共產黨裡面到處都是小人。習近平在這個官場混了很久，他知道共產黨是什麼德行。這個黨本身很爛的。」
馮崇義認為，主要是因為習近平本身德不配位，造成中共內外交困，也斷了很多官員的財路。自從他上台以來，官員普遍躺平，多一事不如少一事，不求有功，只求無過。「因為習近平搞政治清算，人人自危，搞到天怒人怨，誰願意為他賣命？」
他表示，習近平現在加大整肅，是為二十一大鳴鑼開路。他就是要鎮住所有人，把終身制搞下去。什麼招都用上了。
澳洲學者、政治學博士林松對大紀元表示，中共官場為什麼會出現這麼多不敢說真話的人，不敢得罪人、不敢承擔責任的官員？因為中共這個制度，平常就是人鬥人，造成很多人都不敢說真話。
他認為，現在中共當局要整頓「老好人」，只是整頓不聽話官員的藉口。主要是在二十一大前，習近平要利用這個表面上看起來很好的理由，試圖去控制局面。

澳门国安首案宣判：区锦新颠覆罪成囚12年半，妻子斥“莫须有迫害” · 茉莉花新闻网 跳转到主要内容 跳转到页脚 在新标签页中打开

星期五（11月6日），澳门完成史上首宗国安审判。民主派领袖区锦新被控“颠覆国家政权”等罪名，于初级法院被判囚12年6个月。
现年69岁的他预料须服刑到2039年，出狱时已年届82岁。根据澳门《刑法典》规定， 服刑至三分之二可申请假释。
判决后，区锦新妻子郑妙珊表示家人对于裁决不可接受 。她发公开信指区案是政治审判，“是人格羞辱的莫须有迫害”。
这是澳门首宗国安案，案件过程并不公开，区锦新由“指派律师”辩护，审理法官及律师身份不明。从预审、开审到宣判，外界只能从政府新闻稿得知消息。
澳门政府表示尊重并支持法院裁决，指政府维护国安、捍卫法治的立场坚定不移。
图像加注文字，区锦新妻子郑妙珊发公开信，指区案是政治审判，“是人格羞辱的莫须有迫害”。
初级法院于今早10点就区案作出裁决。法院判处区锦新四罪名成立：
根据法院裁决，在7月2日的预审中，区锦新被起诉七宗罪：三项“颠覆国家政权罪”、三项“与境外组织联系危害国家安全”罪，以及《刑法典》下一项“违反保密”罪。
就“颠覆国家政权罪”，法庭指出，事实显示区锦新“长期亲身协助和配合”境外组织，“收集、预备，及散布充斥颠覆国家政权的政治主张，以及虚假歪曲的图片及资讯”，藉此勾连境外组织煽动仇恨，以图推翻中国国家根本制度。而相关行为在《维护国家安全法》于2023年修订生效后仍然持续。
这一行为同时触犯“与境外组织联系危害国家安全”罪，但因两罪存在表面竞合关系，以较重罪的“颠覆国家政权罪”作处罚。
至于另外被起诉的两项“颠覆国家政权罪”及两项“与境外组织联系危害国家安全”，法庭指出，在2023至2024年期间，区锦新先后与多个境外组织勾连，亲身协助其收集虚假且歪曲消息、合谋散布，意图使外国作出针对中国及澳门的敌对行动、引发仇恨，以及破坏澳门特首选举。
就这行为，两项“与境外组织联系危害国家安全罪”成立，但两项“颠覆国家政权罪”因为嫌犯行为是否达至“推翻、破坏程度”的要求存在疑问，罪名不成立。
最后《刑法典》下“违反保密罪”一罪，法庭表示区锦新2021年身为时任立法会议员，把参加立法会“土地及公共批给事务跟进委员会”有关赌牌续期闭门会议的秘密内容向境外组织泄漏，认定“违反保密罪”罪成。
法庭在判案理由中指出，尽管嫌犯为初犯，且承认作出相当部分的犯罪事实，“惟其故意程度极高，有关犯罪的不法性程度及可能造成的后果均十分严重”。
经审议后，就“颠覆国家政权罪”判囚11年3个月；两项“与境外组织联系危害国家安全罪”，各判囚3年9个月；“违反保密罪”判囚9个月。
经合议，法庭最后决定判处区锦新单一刑罚12年6个月。
图像加注文字，2026年9月16日，区锦新案开审，澳门治安警察警员在初级法院外戒备。
据在场媒体表示，押送区锦新的囚车于上午9时38分驶入澳门西湾初级法院。
在法院外，道路被封，现场有大量保安和警察看守。法院对出空地设有传媒区，大批无法进入法院的传媒只能在此等候，现场约有20人。
是次宣判消息公布来得突然。11月5日初级法院于下午3点发新闻稿，表示区案将于明早10点公开宣判。欲旁听的公众及传媒须分别在4点起到法院及新闻局的线上系统登记。
但有市民发文表示，4点02分左右到达法院，已有职员表示“已经取完筹，额满了”。当局没透露旁听席数量为何。另据BBC中文了解，有本地媒体表示成功在新闻局系统登记后，获告知“没有足够的位置”无法旁听。
今早新闻局向现场媒体确认，只得四间传媒出席旁听，包括澳门广播电视中文及葡文台、澳门日报及大众报。BBC中文联系新闻局确认消息，截至发稿前未有回覆。
这是澳门首宗闭门国安案。自区锦新被羁押后，案件一直沉寂，至相隔接近一年，外界方得知案件进展。
今年7月9日，初级法院无预警宣布区案于一周前完成预审，控罪扩展至三罪：“颠覆国家政权”、“与境外组织联系危害国家安全”罪，以及“违反保密”罪。
值得注意的是，澳门当局从无公开案件案情。区锦新家人曾向媒体表示，家人无法为其委托辩护律师，且接近一年无法与他联系。
区锦新最后获法院“指派律师”辩护，但当局并无公开“官派律师”的身份。
根据澳门国安法，“颠覆国家政权”罪可处十年至25年徒刑，“与境外组织联系危害国家安全”罪可处三年至十年徒刑；而刑法典下，“违反保密”罪可处最高一年徒刑，或科最高240日罚金——罚金之日额为澳门元50元不等。
图像加注文字，2017年，为区锦新（左）最后一届参选立法会。
区锦新原是一名小学老师。在1989年六四事件发生后，与吴国昌等人筹组“澳门民主发展联委会”，提出“回应中国民主运动、推动澳门民主发展”，成为澳门此后30年“六四烛光晚会”的组织者。
他自1993年起担任澳门市政议员，在1999年主权移交后与吴国昌相继成为立法会议员；连同于2016年当选的苏嘉豪，成为立法会内唯一三名民主派议员。
2021年，担任超过20年议员的区锦新宣布不再寻求连任。拍档吴国昌与苏嘉豪则于同年被撤销参选资格。澳门特区终审法院驳回吴苏二人上诉，理由是组织六四悼念属“诽谤”中国政府、可视为不拥护澳门《基本法》。民联会后因压力于2023年解散。
不过，区锦新在卸任议员后，仍常在Facebook和媒体采访中评论时政。他最后一则Facebook帖文写在被捕当日，评论澳门第四条与氹仔的跨海大桥。
区锦新拥有葡萄牙国籍。2025年7月30日，区被捕后，欧盟对外行动署谴责中方抓捕欧洲公民，并称相关行动“加深了外界对澳门特别行政区政治多元化及言论自由持续遭侵蚀的忧虑”。
总部设在纽约的人权观察组织当时也发声明称：“拘捕区锦新反映中国领导人习近平的高压统治向外延伸，由中国扩大到香港和澳门。”
中国外交部驻澳门公署其后批评欧盟“蓄意攻击澳门法治、粗暴干涉澳门事务和中国内政”，“敦促欧盟立即停止对澳门事务说三道四、无端指责，立即停止干预澳门事务和中国内政”。

高市发表台湾言论一年后，日中关系几乎没有解冻的迹象
2025 年 11 月 7 日，日本首相高市早苗表示，中国对台湾的封锁可能威胁到日本的生存，因此日本和中国之间的紧张关系加剧，需要采取集体自卫权。 |集集
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads 电子邮件 打印 书签故事 复制链接
周六，东京将纪念日本首相高市早苗关于日本可能军事干预台湾危机的言论引发与北京的外交破裂一周年——由于双方仍顽固地存在分歧，这一裂痕几乎没有任何弥合的迹象。
中日之间持续不断的争端始于高市于 2025 年 11 月 7 日在国会发表讲话，他表示，在“最坏的情况”下，例如中国海军封锁台湾，日本可以根据集体自卫权部署自卫队，日本首相称这可能对日本构成“生存威胁的局面”。
这些言论是现任首相首次详细阐述东京可能如何应对台海危机的具体案例，引发了北京的愤怒。中国宣称台湾是自己的领土，并誓言要将这个民主岛屿置于其控制之下，必要时将使用武力。

Few signs of thaw in Japan-China relations one year after Takaichi’s Taiwan remarks
Tensions between Japan and China flared after Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi said on Nov. 7, 2025, that a Chinese blockade of Taiwan could threaten Japan’s survival and warrant the use of collective self-defense. | JIJI
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads Email Print Bookmark story Copy link
Tokyo on Saturday will mark one year since Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi’s remarks about the possibility of a Japanese military intervention in a Taiwan crisis triggered a diplomatic rupture with Beijing — a rift that shows few signs of closing as the two sides remain stubbornly at odds.
The ongoing dispute between China and Japan began following Takaichi’s remarks in parliament on Nov. 7, 2025, that the Self-Defense Forces could be deployed under the right to collective self-defense in “worst-case” scenarios, such as a Chinese naval blockade of Taiwan, which the prime minister said could constitute a “survival-threatening situation” for Japan.
The comments, the first by a sitting prime minister to detail a specific case of how Tokyo might respond to a Taiwan Strait crisis, triggered outrage in Beijing. China claims Taiwan as its own and has vowed to bring the democratic island under its control, by force if necessary.

content:
普京没收日本烟草资产，与日本关系进一步紧张 - 日本时报
普京没收日本烟草资产，与日本关系进一步紧张
日本烟草公司东京总部的标志|路透社
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads 电子邮件 打印 书签故事 复制链接
俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京颁布法令，暂时扣押日本烟草公司（JTI）的俄罗斯资产，进一步加剧与日本的关系紧张。
周四的举动立即引起东京方面的回应，贸易大臣赤泽亮正和其他官员呼吁俄罗斯撤回该措施。
赤泽周五表示：“我们一再要求俄罗斯方面确保日本公民和企业的合法利益不受损害。”他补充说，日本政府一直对俄罗斯的这一举动保持警惕，俄罗斯一直在加大力度，从其所谓不友好的西方国家手中夺取当地企业的控制权。
此次扣押事件发生之际，普京8月访问择捉岛（北海道东海岸附近四个俄罗斯控制、日本声称拥有主权的岛屿之一），以及俄罗斯上个月以间谍罪名拘留北海道新闻记者今井由纪，东京和莫斯科之间的紧张关系加剧。
普京的命令直接影响了日本烟草国际公司的四家制造工厂，其中包括日本烟草公司旗下位于圣彼得堡、顿河畔罗斯托夫的两家卷烟工厂，以及利佩茨克和列宁格勒地区的另外两家卷烟工厂。 JTI 在俄罗斯拥有约 4,000 名员工。
东京 JT 集团周五发表声明称，其俄罗斯业务运营符合所有适用的法规和制裁，目前正在收集更多信息并考虑下一步行动。
俄罗斯塔斯社称，普京的命令是基于2023年4月颁布的一项法令，该法令建立了临时扣押属于不友好国家实体资产的机制。塔斯社表示，这是对其他国家对俄罗斯国民实施制裁并扣押其资产的回应。
2022年2月俄罗斯入侵乌克兰后，美国、日本、欧盟等国对莫斯科实施经济制裁和限制。
JTI自1999年成立以来一直在俄罗斯开展业务，自2007年以来一直是俄罗斯烟草市场的顶级公司。JT集团的最大股东是财政部，拥有该公司37.55%的股份。根据法律规定，日本政府必须始终拥有至少三分之一的 JT 已发行股票。
目前尚不清楚日烟国际的资产将受到临时控制多久。赤泽周五没有就该问题与俄罗斯的外交努力细节发表评论，但表示日本将继续与俄罗斯合作，保护日本公司在当地的资产。

Putin seizes Japan Tobacco assets, further straining relations with Japan - The Japan Times
Putin seizes Japan Tobacco assets, further straining relations with Japan
The logo of Japan Tobacco at its headquarters in Tokyo | REUTERS
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads Email Print Bookmark story Copy link
Russian President Vladimir Putin has issued a decree to temporarily seize Japan Tobacco Inc.’s (JTI) Russian assets, further straining relations with Japan.
The Thursday move drew an immediate response from Tokyo, with trade minister Ryosei Akazawa and other officials calling on Russia to withdraw the measure.
“We have repeatedly requested that the Russian side ensure that the legitimate interests of Japanese citizens and companies are not harmed,” Akazawa said Friday, adding that the government had been on alert for such a move by Russia, which has been widening its push to take control of local businesses from Western countries it calls unfriendly.
The seizure comes amid increased tensions between Tokyo and Moscow over Putin’s August visit to Etorofu, one of four Russia-held, Japanese-claimed islands off the east coast of Hokkaido, and Russia’s detention of Hokkaido Shimbun journalist Yuki Imai last month on espionage charges.
Putin’s order directly impacts four JTI manufacturing plants, including two cigarette factories in St. Petersburg, Rostov-on-Don — owned by JT International — as well as two others in the Lipetsk and Leningrad regions. JTI employs about 4,000 people in Russia.
The JT Group in Tokyo released a statement Friday saying its Russian business operations are in compliance with all applicable regulations and sanctions, and that it is currently gathering more information and considering next steps.
Russia’s TASS news agency said that Putin’s order is based on a decree issued in April 2023 that established a mechanism for temporarily seizing assets belonging to entities from unfriendly countries. It was a response to sanctions placed on Russian nationals and the seizure of their assets by other countries, TASS said.
Following Russia’s invasion of Ukraine in February 2022, the United States, Japan, the European Union and other nations placed economic sanctions and restrictions on Moscow.
JTI has been operating in Russia since the establishment of the company in 1999 and has been the top company in the Russian tobacco market since 2007. The JT Group’s largest shareholder is the Finance Ministry, which owns 37.55% of the firm. By law, the Japanese government must always own at least one-third of JT’s issued shares.
It was not clear how long JTI’s assets would be under temporary control. Akazawa did not comment Friday on the details of diplomatic efforts with Russia over the issue, but said Japan would continue to work with Russia to protect the assets of Japanese companies there.

title: Joshua Wong sentencing: Local gov’t, police, officials hail 10-year jail term amid condemnation from foreign gov’t’s, NGOs
zh_title: 黄之锋判刑：在外国政府和非政府组织的谴责下，当地政府、警察和官员欢呼 10 年监禁
summary: 被监禁的香港民主活动人士黄之锋周四在承认串通外国势力罪后被判处 10 年监禁，这是他根据北京实施的国家安全法第二次被定罪。黄之锋.资料图片：HKFP。另请参阅：黄之锋在 30 多岁时寻求宽大处理，以获释，缓刑信显示 HKFP 收集了本地和国际反应。当地反应：特首黄李俊是“破坏香港繁荣稳定的罪魁祸首之一……黄志峰屡次违法，
content:
被监禁的香港民主活动人士黄之锋周四在承认串通外国势力罪后被判处 10 年监禁，这是他根据北京实施的国家安全法第二次被定罪。黄之锋.资料图片：HKFP。另请参阅：黄之锋在 30 多岁时寻求宽大处理，以获释，缓刑信显示 HKFP 收集了本地和国际反应。
当地反应：行政长官黄李家是“破坏香港繁荣稳定的罪魁祸首之一……黄志峰屡次触犯法律，包括组织、参与、煽动他人参加未经批准的集会、非法集会、藐视法庭等，表现出对法律的彻底漠视。”中国外交部发言人郭家琨表示，中国中央政府坚定支持香港特别行政区维护国家安全，依法惩治危害国家安全的行为。香港立法会发言人表示：“这个判刑充分体现了法治和正义，体现了根据香港国安法，任何企图危害国家安全的人都必然会依法受到严惩……针对黄志峰的证据确凿，他选择认罪……”对于国家和香港特区来说，他一定要抓住机会，学会如何尊重法律，正确认识自己的国家。”保安局局长邓克里斯表示：“那些对我们发动袭击的人，与黄、罗勾结的外部势力一模一样……他们必须受到强烈谴责，香港也应该受到谴责。”
推动社会变革的年轻人是任何充满活力的社会的财富，但香港政府却将他们关进监狱。”国际特赦组织副区域主任萨拉·布鲁克斯（Sarah Brooks）表示：“今天的判决再次严峻地提醒我们，香港的国家安全法如何成为惩罚异议的工具，而不是惩罚异见人士的工具。”

【原文 English Original】
Jailed Hong Kong pro-democracy activist Joshua Wong was sentenced to 10 years’ imprisonment on Thursday after pleading guilty to conspiring to collude with foreign forces, his second conviction under a Beijing-imposed national security law. Joshua Wong. File photo: HKFP. See also: Joshua Wong sought leniency to be freed in his 30s, mitigation letter reveals HKFP rounds up local and international reactions. Local reactions: Chief Executive John Lee Wong was “among the primary culprits responsible for undermining Hong Kong’s prosperity and stability… Wong Chi-fung has repeatedly broken the law, including organising, taking part in, and inciting others to take part in unauthorised assemblies, unlawful assemblies, and contempt of court, demonstrating his utter disregard for the law.” Chinese Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Guo Jiakun “The central government of China firmly supports the Hong Kong SAR in safeguarding national security and punishing in accordance with the law acts that endanger national security.” Spokesperson for the Hong Kong Legislative Council “The sentence fully demonstrates the rule of law and justice, reflecting that under the Hong Kong National Security Law, anyone attempting to endanger national security will inevitably be severely punished in accordance with the law… [T]he evidence against Wong Chi-fung was conclusive and he chose to plead guilty…” Chief Superintendent of Police National Security Department Steve Li “I sincerely hope that for the rest of his time in prison, apart from reflecting on the wrongdoings he has done to the country and to the Hong Kong SAR, he must seize the opportunity to learn how to respect the law and properly understand his own country.” Secretary for Security Chris Tang “Those launching attacks against us are exactly the same external forces that Wong and Law attempted to collude… They must be strongly condemned, and Hong Kong citizens must recognise and acknowledge that clearly.” International reactions: European Union External Action Press Team: “The EU urges Chinese and the Hong Kong authorities to respect international legal commitments under the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights and the 1984 Sino-British Joint Declaration and maintain space for political pluralism in line with the ‘one country, two systems’ principle.” Spokesperson for the UK Foreign Office “We call for an immediate end to all unjust prosecutions of individuals charged under the National Security Law and urge the authorities in China and Hong Kong to honour the rights and freedoms guaranteed to the people of Hong Kong under the Sino-British joint declaration (1984).” Spokesperson for the US Consulate “Wong has been unjustly imprisoned since December 2020, demonstrating that Beijing will go to extraordinary lengths to silence those who advocate for fundamental freedoms in Hong Kong.” Taiwan Presidential Office Spokesperson Karen Kuo “Seeking democracy should not be a crime, and young people should not have to sacrifice their freedom for their ideals.” NGOs Asia Director at Human Rights Watch Elaine Pearson “The harsh sentence on baseless charges against Joshua Wong is cruel and unjust. Young people promoting social change are an asset for any vibrant society, but the Hong Kong government puts them behind bars.” Deputy Regional Director for Amnesty International Sarah Brooks “Today’s sentence is another grim reminder of how Hong Kong’s National Security Law has become a tool to punish dissent rather than to genuinely protect national security… [it] cruelly – and perhaps deliberately – comes mere months before he would have been eligible for release under his previous conviction.”

content: 原创  黄平、DeepSeek  大湾区评论   2026年11月4日 【地缘科技“平”论】第33期 编者按 美国中期选举牵动全球目光，通胀、油价与对外战事成为选民给执政党打分的考题。但民主党掀起“蓝潮”，就意味着美国向左转、川普路线被否定？别急着把对执政者的不满，读成对另一套政治理念的认同。 本文提出一个值得讨论的判断：选票可以改变国会席位，却未必改变美国政治的深层走向。贫富分化与民粹情绪推动两党向右，而美国仍拥有强大的科技创新体系。看懂美国，既不能只看谁赢了选举，也不能用“衰落”二字概括一切。本篇文章，带你跳出两党输赢的热闹，看清美国的变化与底牌。 2026年11月3日，美国举行中期选举。这是川普第二任期内第一次全国性的“打分”：众议院全部435个席位改选，参议院100席中的35席重选，另有36个州长职位待定。选前共和党以53比47的微弱多数控制参议院，众议院同样握有微弱优势。民主党要翻盘，众议院只需净增4席，参议院也只需净增4席——门槛之低，本就预示着一场“执政党挨打”是大概率事件。 截至本文发稿（北京时间11月4日晚8时），民主 党已经在本次中期选举的胜势已经彻底明朗：众议院控制权落定，参议院除密西西比州、阿拉斯加州仍在焦灼外，归属也已基本清晰。开票结果与选前民调方向一致，但翻盘的纵深远超预期——众议院层面，民主党在已经获得25席翻转并拿下控制权的情况下，有望冲击260席大胜；参议院则指向54席的翻盘，并存在最终斩获56席的可能。 更值得注意的是，蓝潮不止在摇摆州，而是深入了深红州的腹地：得克萨斯州民主党候选人塔拉里科对共和党候选人帕克斯顿领先7个百分点——而该州自1988年以来再没选出过民主党参议员；堪萨斯自1932年以来再未出过民主党参议员，这次也进入了蓝军的射程；俄亥俄的布朗、缅因的杰克逊、艾奥瓦和阿拉斯加的民主党人，全都在挑战共和党席位。 州长层面同样如此：俄亥俄的阿克顿对拉马斯瓦米领先6个百分点，得克萨斯的希诺霍萨领先阿博特7个百分点。按奈特·西尔弗的说法，这是一场“蓝色海啸”。 面对这场蓝潮，出现了两种典型解读。一种是欢呼：美国选民终于用选票对川普“用脚投票”，美国政治正在纠偏、向左回归，那个“正常的美国”要回来了。另一种则冷静得多：这不过是“执政党中期选举丢席位”的又一次常规重演，不必过度解读。 笔者认为，这两种解读都只对了一半。翻盘是真的，但“左转”是假的；更准确地说，这场翻盘不是美国右转的反转，而是美国政治整体右转的又一层确认。真正需要担心的，从来不是华盛顿换了谁，而是那个我们熟悉的、总在替世界操心的美国，再也回不来了。 由此，本文要回答三个问题：这场翻盘到底说明了什么、说明不了什么？民主党与共和党，真的有我们以为的那么大差别吗？在变与不变之间，什么才是决定下一个十年世界走向的东西？ 在密歇根州底特律市格罗斯波因特民主党俱乐部举行的选举之夜观票会（图源：CNN） 01 翻盘是真的，但别急着宣布“美国左转” 大众民主的第一母议题，永远是经济。这次翻盘的经济底色极为清晰：选前川普的整体支持率只有35%，对其经济施政的认可度更是低到25%（美联社—NORC口径）；9月消费者价格指数同比上涨3.7%，能源价格高企，再加上对伊朗战争的持续消耗，普通家庭的钱包与安全感同时告急。在这种时候，意识形态再响亮也要给面包让路。 1992年克林顿竞选时，顾问詹姆斯·卡维尔在白板上写下的那句名言至今仍是铁律——“笨蛋，问题是经济”。选民惩罚川普，惩罚的是通胀、是油价、是战争，而不是在思想市场上认真比较了左派与右派的方案之后，投下了“左转”的一票。 执政党在中期选举被翻盘，是美国政治的常规操作，而非政治光谱的转向。自1934年以来，除了1934年（罗斯福）、1998年（克林顿）、2002年（小布什）三个例外，执政党几乎逢中期选举必丢众议院——1994年克林顿、2006年小布什、2010年奥巴马、2018年川普、2022年拜登，无一幸免。这背后的底层逻辑，是大众民主天然的反建制性：中期选举没有总统候选人可供“投其所好”，于是成为民众“用选票发泄对现状不满”的出口。这出口的阀门，表达的是“我不要现状”，而不是“我要左”或“我要右”。 因此，这场翻盘不能读成“美国人民转向进步主义”。翻盘的对象是川普的执政表现，而不是美国政治的右转方向。恰恰相反，一个常常被忽略的事实是：被选民推向胜利的那个民主党，本身也早已右转。把“民主党赢”等同于“美国向左”，是这场选举最大的误读。 要看清这一点，得先回答第二个问题——两党之间，到底还有多大差别？ 02 两党不是左右之分，而是都往右跑    传统的民主党与共和党，差别确实巨大。民主党源出1828年安德鲁·杰克逊的平民政治，共和党1854年因反奴隶制而建，林肯是其第一位总统。到罗斯福“新政”之后，两党逐渐完成了清晰的左右分工：民主党成为工人、少数族裔、工会与“大政府”的政党，共和党则代表企业、小政府与社会保守势力。这套左右轴心，是冷战以来我们理解美国政治的默认坐标系。 转折发生在2016年前后：两党开始了一场静默的“角色互换”。川普让共和党从“大企业＋小政府”转向“工薪白人＋反全球化＋保护主义”，锈带的“红脖子”成为基本盘，关税、移民、制造业回流成为口号——这原本是当年民主党的平民路线。与此同时，民主党越来越深地绑定硅谷、华尔街与好莱坞的捐款和议程，成为大资本与专业精英的政党——这原本是当年共和党的生态位。结果是：共和党越来越像过去的民主党，民主党越来越像过去的共和党。 更深一层，在民粹化的土壤上，两党早已不是“极左对极右”，而是同时向右。笔者判断，根本原因在于社会的民粹化：当全社会的主导情绪是反建制、反移民、反全球化、要安全、要边界，能够收割民意的就只有右翼叙事，“左”的空间被系统性挤压。于是民主党翻盘，靠的往往不是提出一套更左的方案，而是把自己包装成建制内“不那么糟的选择”，甚至直接收编右翼议题。美国的政治轴心，早已不是左右之争，而是右与更右之争。理解了这一点，翻盘就不令人困惑了——它动摇不了美国的政治方向，只更换了这台右转机器上的驾驶员。 03 美国变了，又没变： 危险就藏在这“不变”里  首先，看美国国内之变。表面上政治在换人，但最根本的结构性变化，是中产群体的塌陷与随之而来的社会民粹化。数十年来美国中产占总收入的比重持续下降（皮尤研究中心长期追踪这一趋势），贫富分化加剧、制造业空心化、锈带失落，社会被撕裂成相互敌视的阵营。川普2016年第一次上台，是这个社会结构变化的结果，而非原因——先有中产塌陷，才有民粹领袖登台；没有川普，也会有别的名字。中期选举的每一次“翻盘”，都只是这片土壤上周期性长出的庄稼。 其次，看美国国际之变。二战之后，美国是国际秩序的建立者与维护者——联合国、国际货币基金组织、世界银行、关贸总协定乃至后来的世界贸易组织、北约，几乎都是它一手搭起来的架子。变化从世纪之交开始：小布什政府发动阿富汗（2001）、伊拉克（2003）战争，绕开联合国单边行动，并以“志愿者联盟”等小圈子绕过既有国际机制，美国从“秩序的维护者”滑向“不尊重秩序的霸权”。再往后，随着硬实力的相对衰退与国内分裂的加深，从川普第一任期起，美国在军事、经济、气候、多边机构等各个领域全面撤退——退出TPP、退出《巴黎协定》、退出世卫组织、压缩对外承诺、不再主动主导许多国际事务。美国正从全球霸权，收缩为区域霸权。 最后，也是最关键的，是看美国不变的部分。政治方向、经济结构、国际定位都在发生根本性的、不可逆的变化，所以我们熟悉的那个美国再也回不来了。但有一件事没有变，甚至还在加强：美国从0到1的科技能力。这里的“科技能力”不只是某项技术，而是支撑它的整个体系——顶尖高校、国家实验室、从半导体到人工智能再到生物技术的一线企业，以及把它们串联起来的风投与资本市场。这一套体系化协同，至今没有第二个国家能整体复制。而在以人工智能、生物技术为核心的第四次工业革命里，科技能力就是下一代国家竞争力的核心。所以可以说，美国在“影响未来的能力”上，其实并没有变。 当然，美国的“变”也给这份“不变”添了变数。政治上的右翼转向，某种程度上正在成为科技能力兑现的障碍——比如当下日益激烈的对数据中心建设的抵制、对移民工程师的收紧，都在拖慢科技能力转化为产业与国力的速度。美国科技能力很强，但它究竟能被推到什么程度，仍有很大的不确定性。 这份“很强但不一定能兑现”的张力，恰恰是未来世界最需要警惕的变量。 2026 年3月，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋（Jensen Huang）在加利福尼亚州圣何塞举行的英伟达 GTC 大会上发表主题演讲（图源：CNN） 04 结语   把“变”与“不变”拼在一起，结论令人不安： 一个握有下一次工业革命全部钥匙的国家，却不再关心世界的发展，只关心自己内部的胜负。 这样的世界，大概率会更不公平、更动荡，也更可能走向战争。这不是危言耸听，而是把两条已经发生的趋势叠加之后的自然推论。 而这个“回不来的美国”，正是我们未来必然要面对的美国。它既不等于旧记忆里那个“自由国际秩序的美国”，也不等于很多人以为的“衰落的美国”。按旧的它来预判，会误判它的克制；按衰落的它来低估，会漏掉它0到1的能力。正确的校准只有一条： 一个科技能力更强、政治方向更右，且越来越不愿当“世界警察”的美国。 回到这场中期选举：蓝潮也好、翻盘也罢，都只是这台机器换了个驾驶员，机器的方向没有变。与其怀念那个回不来的美国，不如为这个已经到来的美国做准备。因为决定下一个十年的，从来不是美国会不会变，而是我们能不能在它变了之后，仍然把自己安排在最安全的位置上。 本文作者 黄平 ：香港中文大学（深圳）前海国际事务研究院副院长，公共政策学院副教授、博士生导师。

title: Britain's tech ambitions depend on minerals made in China, MPs warn
zh_title: 议员警告称，英国的科技雄心依赖于中国制造的矿物
summary: 英国对人工智能、先进芯片和清洁能源的雄心依赖于中国主导的矿产供应链，议员们表示，他们无法确定部长们是否有可靠的计划来减少这种依赖。下议院商业、创新、科学和贸易委员会为部长们设定了十项测试，以确保关键矿物的安全。它的裁决并不乐观——它不能确信政府会通过其中任何一项。这些测试涵盖部长们是否知道哪些行业和技术需要保护、他们需要哪些矿物、哪些地方的供应可能会受到干扰，以及国内如何保护这些产业和技术。
content:
英国对人工智能、先进芯片和清洁能源的雄心依赖于中国主导的矿产供应链，议员们表示，他们无法确定部长们是否有可靠的计划来减少这种依赖。下议院商业、创新、科学和贸易委员会为部长们设定了十项测试，以确保关键矿物的安全。它的裁决并不乐观——它不能确信政府会通过其中任何一项。这些测试涵盖部长们是否知道哪些行业和技术需要保护、需要哪些矿产、哪些地方的供应可能会受到干扰，以及国内生产、海外合作伙伴关系、技能和融资将如何缩小差距。在今天发布的一份报告中，该委员会警告说，供应多样化将需要 10 到 15 年的时间，并且需要持续的投资以及与盟友的合作。报告称，将中国完全排除在外既不现实也不可取。让北京拥有如此大的影响力则是另一回事。关键矿物支撑着从电池和半导体到数据中心和军事设备的一切。该称号反映了它们的经济或安全重要性以及对供应中断的脆弱性，而不是一个特别独特的地质俱乐部的成员资格。英国与包括美国、欧盟、日本和印度在内的几乎所有主要工业化经济体一样，几乎完全依赖这些材料和矿产品的进口。
但在中国境外开采更多矿石只能解决部分问题。更大的瓶颈是加工。该委员会援引国际能源署的数据称，中国是 20 种战略矿产中 19 种的领先炼油国，平均市场份额为 70%。矿井上方的不同旗帜并不一定意味着通过炼油厂的路线不同。暴露的范围不仅仅限于芯片和电池。正如 The Register 在 8 月份报道的那样，铒用于放大光纤链路中的信号，而钇则用于陶瓷电容器等组件。 IEEE Spectrum 警告说，中国实际上垄断了制造商所需的工业可用材料的加工。这种集中已经造成了破坏。中国于 2025 年 4 月在美国征收关税后实施稀土出口管制，波及制造业供应链，并迫使汽车工厂临时关闭。即使英国不是预定目标，英国制造商也可能遭受损失。该委员会还重点介绍了用于雷达、通信和电子战的先进半导体的镓和锗。报告显示，中国的产量分别占全球的 95% 和 93%。北京在芯片材料方面发挥影响力并不新鲜。随着西方对半导体技术的限制收紧，中国于 2023 年 7 月宣布了镓和锗的出口许可要求。
然而议员们表示，政府尚未明确确定要保护哪些国内工业和技术能力，因此很难确定哪些供应链值得优先考虑。进口统计数据也没有揭示全部风险。矿物质可能会进入电池、磁铁和其他制造部件内部，并作为单独的材料从视野中消失。企业本身可能并不确切地知道其供应链中几层的情况。该委员会希望与c中的公司进行保密的映射和压力测试

【原文 English Original】
Britain's ambitions for AI, advanced chips, and clean energy rest on mineral supply chains dominated by China, and MPs say they cannot establish whether ministers have a credible plan to reduce that dependence. The House of Commons Business, Innovation, Science and Trade Committee has set ministers ten tests for securing critical minerals. Its verdict is hardly glowing – it cannot be confident the government passes any of them. The tests cover whether ministers know which industries and technologies need protecting, what minerals they require, where supplies could be disrupted, and how domestic production, overseas partnerships, skills, and financing will close the gaps. In a report published today , the committee warns that diversifying supplies will take ten to 15 years, and will require sustained investment and cooperation with allies. Completely cutting China out is neither realistic nor desirable, it says. Leaving Beijing with so much leverage is another matter. Critical minerals underpin everything from batteries and semiconductors to datacenters and military equipment. The designation reflects their economic or security importance and vulnerability to supply disruption, rather than membership of an especially exclusive geological club. The UK – like pretty much all major industrialized economies including the US, the EU, Japan, and India – is almost entirely dependent on imports of these materials and mineral product s. But digging up more ore outside China would solve only part of the problem. The bigger bottleneck is processing. Citing International Energy Agency figures, the committee says China is the leading refiner for 19 of 20 strategic minerals, with an average market share of 70 percent. A different flag over the mine does not necessarily mean a different route through the refinery. The exposure extends beyond chips and batteries. As The Register reported in August , erbium is used to amplify signals in fiber-optic links, while yttrium goes into components including ceramic capacitors. IEEE Spectrum warned that China effectively monopolized the processing of both into the industrially usable materials manufacturers need. That concentration has already caused disruption. China's rare earth export controls in April 2025 , introduced following US tariffs, rippled through manufacturing supply chains and forced temporary automotive plant closures. British manufacturers can suffer even when Britain isn't the intended target. The committee also highlights gallium and germanium, used in advanced semiconductors for radar, communications, and electronic warfare. China accounts for 95 percent and 93 percent of their global production respectively, according to the report [PDF]. Beijing flexing its leverage over chip materials is not new. China announced export licensing requirements for gallium and germanium in July 2023 amid tightening Western restrictions on semiconductor technology. Yet MPs say the government has not clearly identified which domestic industrial and technological capabilities it wants to protect, making it difficult to determine which supply chains deserve priority. Nor do import statistics reveal the whole exposure. Minerals can arrive inside batteries, magnets, and other manufactured components, disappearing from view as individual materials. Businesses themselves may not know precisely what lies several layers down their supply chains. The committee wants confidential mapping and stress-testing with firms in critical sectors, followed by joint purchasing arrangements with allies to give new mining and refining projects dependable customers. Committee chair Liam Byrne said: "Critical minerals are the alpha of the new economy. We cannot re-arm Britain, build AI or deliver net zero unless we secure the minerals these technologies depend on. "Yet sixteen years after China first weaponised its chokehold over rare earths , Britain remains dangerously exposed. We don't know enough about what minerals we need or where to find them. Our energy costs make processing uneconomic, we're exporting valuable metal waste, and our public finance institutions are shackled by outdated rules." More than a shopping list The committee's five-part prescription is to identify the capabilities Britain must protect, map their mineral needs, expand domestic mining, processing, and recycling, pool purchasing power with allies, and establish a dedicated financing facility. The proposed facility would bring together public funding bodies to back projects through grants, equity, loans, guarantees, and long-term purchase agreements. "We're never going to eliminate Chinese minerals from our supply chains. But it's foolish to leave Britain exposed to economic coercion when we could be building alternative supplies," Byrne said. "That's why we need a new Critical Minerals Finance Facility with the financial firepower to invest in new mines, processing plants and recycling, working with our allies to share the costs." The report argues that existing institutions leave gaps, particularly for early-stage projects. It recommends expanding UK Export Finance's remit and allowing British International Investment to take equity stakes in overseas mineral projects. Long-term purchasing commitments and price guarantees could help keep strategically important projects commercially viable despite volatile mineral prices. There is also material closer to home. The report says 80 percent of UK metal products classified as waste are exported. MPs want better sorting and separation infrastructure, alongside more detailed trade data to establish exactly what valuable scrap is leaving the country. For domestic projects, they recommend designated critical mineral clusters with permitting deadlines, help navigating approvals, energy support, and priority grid access. Stockpiles could provide a short-term buffer too. The committee calls for an initial reserve covering approximately 60 days of minerals needed for defense capabilities, while stressing that warehouses are no substitute for diversified supply. None of this offers a quick escape from dependence on China. The committee's argument is that Britain needs to decide what it must protect, work out what those industries actually consume, and help finance alternatives before the next disruption. "De-risking even a prudent proportion of our supplies will take over a decade. Britain cannot afford to drift," Byrne said. "We must act now before dangerous dependencies become strategic liabilities." ®

title: 美國中期選舉：共和黨失去兩院，對華政策與對台軍售會轉向嗎？

content:
美國中期選舉：共和黨失去兩院，對華政策與對台軍售會轉向嗎？ - BBC News 中文
圖像加註文字，學者向BBC中文分析，會談最重要的成就在於展示兩國關係「正面友好的氛圍和形象」。
美國中期選舉結果出爐，民主黨在參眾兩院同時翻盤，共和黨總統特朗普（Donald Trump，又譯川普）的第二任期後半段將在「跛腳」狀態下展開。這場選舉不只改變華盛頓的權力版圖，也可能牽動美中關係與台灣議題的走向。
時機尤其敏感。11月18至19日，亞太經合組織（APEC）領導人峰會將在深圳舉行；12月中，特朗普與習近平還可能在邁阿密G20峰會再度會面。價值140億美元的對台軍售案正卡在特朗普手中，他今年5月曾公開稱這筆軍售是「很好的談判籌碼」。民主黨掌控國會後，出口管制、晶片限制與軍售節奏會否出現新的拉鋸，成為觀察焦點。
多位專家向BBC中文分析，美國兩黨在對華問題上的共識深厚，總統仍是政策主導者，大方向不會因國會易主而改變；真正的變化在於監督力度，民主黨將透過聽證會、傳票、《國防授權法》與撥款法案，嚴格審視特朗普與北京達成的貿易休戰。
與此同時，多位長期支持台灣的共和黨「台灣連線」議員落馬，也意味著台北必須重新經營與新生代民主黨議員的關係。
「特習會」後兩架美國 F-16V 抵台 「雖遲但到」的時機與信號2026年10月5日
詳解美國破紀錄對台軍售：價值111億美元的非對稱式防禦藍圖2025年12月19日
美國智庫太平洋論壇（Pacific Forum）兼任研究員藍若思（Elizabeth Larus）向BBC中文表示，無論國會由哪個黨派掌握多數，美國對台灣的支持及對華政策都不會改變，兩黨都會試圖推動特朗普批准桌上那筆140億美元的對台軍售案。
「自1979年以來，每一任美國總統都維持了《台灣關係法》、『六項保證』以及美國的『一個中國』政策，這些都不會因為民主黨掌控國會而改變。」她說。
美國智庫德國馬歇爾基金會（German Marshall Fund, GMF）亞洲計畫主任葛來儀（Bonnie Glaser）預測，民主黨將掌控撥款程序與參議院議程，很可能在《國防授權法》（NDAA）與撥款法案中加入多項要求：加速交付已核准的對台武器、新的對外軍售（FMS）案件通報、對台使用外國軍事融資（FMF），以及台灣安全合作倡議（Taiwan Security Cooperation Initiative）資金。《六項保證法案》（Six Assurances Act）也可能獲得更多推進動能。
葛來儀還指出，民主黨大勝後，美國可能加強對中國取得先進晶片的限制，《安全晶片法案》（Safe Chips Act）有機會通過。但特朗普擁有否決權，民主黨票數不足以推翻，除非部分共和黨議員倒戈支持。
新加坡南洋理工大學公共政策與全球事務副教授駱明輝（Dylan Loh）對BBC中文表示：「美國對中國存在廣泛共識，整體關係的塑造仍主要由總統主導。」
新加坡獨立分析師鄧銘杰也不認為民主黨大勝會帶來更溫和的對華政策。兩大黨在出口管制、晶片限制與供應鏈措施上立場一致，實際變化在於監督力度：民主黨將透過聽證會與傳票，嚴格審視貿易休戰和「建設性戰略穩定」框架。
